| slar yang 'phral du skyes pa nyid du gyur to/ /sprul pa la ni rang rgyud pa'i lus su mi brtag ste/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag ces bya ba/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ sha ri'i bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das las kyi sgrib pa ci lta bu zhig gis/ bu mo 'dis bud med kyi dngos po bzung*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' dag ni las kyi sgrib pas bud med kyi dngos po yongs su mi 'dzin to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na | sha ra dwa ti'i bu byang chub sems dpa' ni/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir mngon par shes pa dang*/ rigs pa dang*/ ye shes dang*/ thabs dang | shes rab kyi stobs kyis bud med kyi dngos po yongs su 'dzin to/ /zhes 'byung ba'i phy-ir dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyang 'dul ba'i dbang gis khye'u dang*/ bu mo dang*/ skyes pa dang*/ bud med dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba la sogs pa'i lus su kun tu ston par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa dgongs pa'i don yang dag par bshad pa ni/ de lta na 'di'i dgongs pa ci zhe na/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du ro gcig pa dang*/ theg pa thams cad theg pa gcig tu grub pas 'bras bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtshor ro gcig par ston pa'i dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i che ba dbyung ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas rin chen mang gi smon lam dang*/ phrin las kyi yongs su bzhag pa'i sku/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas pad+ma dkar po'i mdo sde 'di bstan pa'i gnas ga la ba der byon te/ mthun 'gyur dang rjes su bsngags pa mdzad pa ni/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed byon zin pa/ de dag thams cad kyis kyang*/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thugs su chud nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ chos kyi tshul 'di nyid bstan pa'i snying por dgongs par bstan pa dang*/

da ltar phyogs brgyad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpag tu med pa rnams byon zhing 'dus nas/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dang | de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la mchod cing*/ bsngags pa brjod pa ni | da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag kyang*/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thugs su chud nas sangs rgyas la chos 'di nyid bstan pa'i snying por mdzad pa bstan pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' bgrang ba las 'das pa rnams kyis bkur zhing*/ rjes su yi rang la mthun par bsngags pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/ chos kyi tshul 'di rtogs nas 'tshang rgya zhing*/ chos 'di nyid bstan pa'i snying por mdzad par 'gyur bar ston te/ de ltar na chos 'di ni/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mkhyen par bya ba dang*/ bstan pa'i snying po yin par bstan to/ /klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i bu mo la 'jam dpal gyis dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po bshad pa'i rkyen tsam gyis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i tshul bstan te/ de'i rgyu mtshan rgyas par gong du bshad pa nyid do/ /tshul 'di thub pa nyid kyis nges bzhag pa'i/ /nges don mdo sde'i dgongs pa nyid yin pas/ /dpang du gyur pa thub pa nyid lags te/ /de dpang 'jog pa'i dpang yang 'jam dpal lags/ /dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig las/ phyin ci log tu brtags pa dgag pa'i tshul 'di ni rang gi slob ma dad pa dang*/ shes rab dang ldan pa/ da sman zhes bya bas gsol ba btab nas dge slong 'phags pas me mo glang gi lo/ nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyin par chu mig dpal gyi bde chen du myur du bris pa'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya ba'o// //༄༅/ /bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo'i don yang dag par bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /theg pa chen po'i man ngag yang dag par bsdus pa zhes bya ba/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'khor grangs med pa 'dus pa'i nang du bu mo rin chen zhes bya bas mu tig gi se mo do phul nas/ sangs rgyas kyis 'dir bstan pa'i chos 'di bdag gis 'dzin zhing rgyas par bgyid par 'gyur na/ bden pa'i stobs des se mo do 'di/ thub pa'i dbu'i steng du khang pa brtsegs par gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag thams cad kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi bkod pa 'di la snang bar gyur cig ces brjod nas phul ba dang | de bzhin du gyur pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ngo mtshar du gyur nas sangs rgyas la zhus pa dang*/ bsngags pa mdzad de/ de nas bu mo rin chen gyis bstod nas/ thog mar byang chub sems dpa'i tshul zhus shing gsungs pa'i rjes su bu mos sems bskyed pa rin po che sum cu rtsa gnyis smras pa ni/ gzhan phyir kun mkhyen nyid du sems bskyed dang*/ /sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob chos 'dzin dge 'dun rgyun/ /mi gcod phyir dang 'gro la byams phyir dang*/ /brtse dang sbyin dang khrims dang bzod pa dang*/ /brtson dang bsam gtan nyid dang shes rab dang*/ /sems can smin dang kun la sems snyoms dang*/ /mtha' dbus med pa'i lta ba rtogs pa dang*/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs dang sangs rgyas mi 'bral dang*/ /dam chos tshol dang chos rab bston pa dang*/ /slob dpon bkur dang nyams pa rjes gzung dang*/ /dman la brnyas med kun la 'dud pa dang*/ / theg dman spangs nas theg mchog lam 'god dang*/ /'khor bar mi skyo 'du 'dzi med pa dang*/ /bdag gi bde ba gzhan la smin pa dang*/ /grol yang 'dus byas yongs su mi 'dor dang*/ /byang chub mchog chos yongs su bsgrub pa dang | | lta ba med pas 'gro la lta ba dang*/ /kun mkhyen don du bskal par mi skyo dang*/ /rang gi phun tshogs rlom med rgud pa la/ /'byor pa sbyor bas sems rab bskyed pa ni/

/rgyal sras rnams kyi rin chen lta bu yi/ /sems bskyed sum cu rtsa gnyis de yis bshad/ /ces pa rnams so/ /de nas thub pas gsungs pa/ bu mo khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa' dag gi sems bskyed pa rin po che la 'jug pa 'di legs par smras pa ni legs so legs so/ /bu mo gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de dag ni skyes bu dam pa yin te/ yon tan bstan pa mtha' yas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nyan thos rin po che dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rin po che las/ sangs rgyas rin po che mi 'byung gi sangs rgyas rin po che las/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rin po che 'byung ngo*/ /byang chub kyi sangs rgyas rin po che 'byung ngo*/ /byang chub kyi sems rin po che las/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun rin po che 'byung ngo | | zhes gsungs so/ /de nas tshig 'ga' zhig gi mthar shā ri'i bus/ bu mo 'dis gang gi tshe gang las sems bskyed/ ces zhus pas/ gsungs pa/ bskal pa grangs med pa'i yang grangs med pa'i gong du 'jig rten gyi khams shin tu rnam par dag pa zhes bya bar sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs/ sku tshe bar gyi bskal pa bcu 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i drung du bsod nams kyi rnam par smin pa yongs su dag pa zhes bya ba'i 'khor los sgyur bar gyur nas/ lo bye ba sum cu rtsa drug tu bsnyen bkur nas sems bskyed do/ /slar yang lo bye ba phrag bcur bsnyen bkur ro/ /mthar rab tu byung ngo*/ /de nas brtsams te spyod pa la zhugs so zhes gsungs so/ /de nas rim gyis bu mos de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu po gang las grub zhus pas/ gsungs pa/ theg dman lam dman spangs nas byang chub lam/ /gnas pa brten pas gnas mkhyen stobs thob 'gyur | | las dang rnam smin la rton gzhan dag kyang*/ /rton du 'jug pas lam mkhyen stobs thob bo/ /de ni 'khor du seng ge'i sgra sgrogs 'gyur/

/dbang po brtags nas chos ston dbang mkhyen stobs/ khams la 'jug cing gnas pas khams mkhyen stobs/ /mos pa brtags nas ston pas mos pa mkhyen/ / theg pa kun bslabs bstan pas kun 'gro mkhyen/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin lhur len nges brtags pas/ /dul zhing cang shes gyur pas dgongs pa mkhyen// dge ba chud mi gson zhing bag yod la/ /dam bcas brtan pas bdag dang gzhan dag gi /sngon gnas rjes su dran pa'i stobs thob bo/ /sems can spa mi bkong zhing mi shes pa'i/ /chos la dbang za mi byed snang byed pas/ /lha mig dag pas 'chi 'pho skye ba mkhyen/ /zag pa spangs phyir chos dang lam bstan pas | | zag pa zad mkhyen stobs ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pas stobs bcu'o | | mi 'jigs pa bzhi gang gis thob/ /ces zhus pa'i lan du/ chos la dpe mkhyud med pas sems can la/ /sems snyoms bdog pa kun gtong mnyam nyid thob/ /tha dad 'du shes bral bas 'khor du ni/ /byang chub rtogs pa dam 'cha' la mi 'jigs/ /gang gis bar chad 'gyur zhes rang dang gzhan/ / mi 'jug pa yis gegs ston 'jigs pa med/ /dkar po'i chos la mos shing rnam byang gis/ /lam rab tu zhugs bstan pas nges 'byung gi /lam ston pa la 'jigs med gsum pa'o/ /bdag gis shes kyi gzhan gyis mi shes zhes/ /nga rgyal med cing sdig med sbyangs pa yis/ /spangs thob ston la mi 'jigs bzhi pa thob/ /ces pa ste mi 'jigs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad gang gis thob ces zhus pa'i lan du/ lam ston lam chos mtshan mo mar me 'bul/ /'gyod dang nyes sel the tshom gcod pa dang*/ /snang byed mi smod nges tshig dbang mi za/ /de yis kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin dang*/ /sgra skad kun la 'jug pa'i gzungs thob pas/ /'khrul pa med par chos ston dang po'o/ / tshig skyon byung rgyal mu cor smra ba spangs/ /bden smra rtsod med chos la 'jug pa dang | | ye shes lhun grub la dad 'dzin du 'jug

/de yi rnam 'phrul rgyal po'i ting 'dzin dang*/ /sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs mkhas 'bad med pas/ /ca co med par kun nas chos ston to/ /rjes dran drug dran dran du 'jug pa dang*/ / chos rnams thams cad dbang bsgyur ting 'dzin dang*/ /chos kyi sgron ma'i gzungs mkhas bsnyel ba med/ /sems can sems bsrung dge ba'i bar mi gcod/ /chos kun sgyu mar mos shing rlom sems med/ /mnyam nyid chos dbyings 'dre ba med par bzhugs/ /de yi chos kun rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid | | rnam par spros pa med pa'i ting 'dzin dang*/ /kun nas 'khyil pa'i gzungs kyi sgo mkhas pas/ /mdzad pa lhun grub mnyam gzhag bzhi pa'o/ / sems dang lta ba phyin ci log med dang*/ /sgro 'dogs pa dang bdag tu 'du shes med/ /sems can srog gso gang zag shed las skyes/ /shed bu rtag chad 'byung 'jig dge mi dge kha na ma tho zag bcas zag med dang*/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das dang nyon mongs dang*/ /rnam byang tha dad 'du shes med goms shing | | der bzhugs pa yi mtshan ma med pa dang*/ /mi zad za ma tog gi gzungs mkhas pas/ /tha dad 'du shes mi chos lnga pa yin/ /bde dang sdug bsngal 'byor dang nyams pa dang*/ /bdag gzhan srid zhi mnyam pa nyid rtogs shing | | gzhan yang der 'jug pa dang gnyis la ni/ /chags las rnam grol ting 'dzin bsgom pa dang*/ /rgya mtsho phyag rgya gzungs la mkhas pa yis/ /ma brtags btang snyoms med pa drug pa'o/ /zab dang rgya che'i ∶dge ba (《 zha 》 chos la )tshol bar nges/ /nyan thos rang rgyal sa spang theg chen las/ /mi ldog sems can mi 'dor gzhan dag gi /dring la mi 'jog mos dang mos pa yis/ /'du byed ting 'dzin rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi/ /gzungs la mkhas pas ston dang mdzad pa la/ /skad cig dus mi 'da' ba'ang mnyam gzhag las/ /mi g.yo 'dun pa nyams med bdun pa'o/ /bsam dang sbyor bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' dang | | bla ma bsten dang yongs 'dri bsnyen bkur dang*/

/sems can smin dang sangs rgyas zhing sbyong dang*/ /chos 'dzin pa dang mngon par byang chub phyir/ / ston dang 'khrul pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang*/ /brtson 'grus 'du byed ting 'dzin bsgom pa dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul dam pa'i cho 'phrul thob pa yi/ /brtson 'grus nyams med 'di ni brgyad pa'o/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i chos dran pa/ /gang gi lus tshor chos sems mi dmigs dang*/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal bdag med mi sdug par/ /dran yang mtshan dpe'i lus bsgrub gzhan dag gi / sdug bsngal tshor ba zhi phyir snying rje dang*/ /byang sems bdag nyid mtha' dbus med pa yi/ /chos la 'jug pa'i dran pa dam pa dang*/ /spong ba'i 'du byed ldan pa'i ting 'dzin dang*/ /kun brjod pa yi cho 'phrul dam pa yis/ /dran pa nyams pa med par lung ston pa/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i ma 'dres dgu pa'o/ /rgya chen rno dang zab pa'i shes rab dang*/ /zil gyis mi gnon nyan thos rang rgyal gyi/ /mi dpogs lhag dang gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog /thos pas mi ngoms chos tshol shes rab kyis/ /bla ma bkur byed mchod phyir kun gtong ba/ /sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pas gsal byas shing*/ /spyod pa'i 'du byed ting 'dzin bsgoms pa dang | | rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dam pa yis/ /shes rab nyams med ma 'dres bcu pa'o/ /'du 'dzi spangs shing dben dang rnal 'byor gzhol/ /rnam thar gsum gyi sgrib med rnam thar bskyed/ /shes rab dang ldan bdud kyi yul las 'das/ /ye shes yul rdzogs byed cing sgrib pa spang*/ /zab mo'i chos ston rton pa bzhi dang ldan/ /lta dang nyon mongs mi mthun phyogs kun spang*/ /dri med snying po'i ting 'dzin bsgoms pa dang*/ /chos kun snang ldan gzungs la mkhas pa yis/ /rnam grol nyams pa med pa bcu gcig pa/ /ye shes rnam dag nyams med sbyangs pa las/ /byung bas yul gang nyon mongs bcas pa dang*/ /nyon mongs med sogs khyad par gang ldan pa/

/nges dang ma nges so so'i skye bo dang | | 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams dang bden pa rnams/ /shes bya mngon du mi byed gzhan dag gis/ /shes phyir chos ston bstan pa de la yang*/ /gnod med chos dang mthun par zhugs pa dang*/ /lugs 'byung bzlog pa'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis so/ /shes shing byed med dus gsum mnyam nyid dang*/ / bsam med don rnams ston pa rgyal ba'i bka'/ /rtsod med 'byung dang 'jig tshul dang bcas shing*/ /mtha' lta ba las rnam par 'das pa'i tshul/ /shes shing de bzhin gzhan la bstan pa dang*/ /stobs bkod pa yi ting 'dzin bsgom pa dang*/ /mtha' yas mkhyen pa'i gzungs la mkhas pa yis/ /ji skad smos pa'i ma 'dres de dag la/ /dbang 'byor rnam grol ye shes bcu gnyis pa/ / rtogs pas bsdus pa'i chos drug go /ye shes dam pa de 'dra dbang byas pa/ / g.yo sgyus bslu dang tshul chos nyid dang yang*/ /chags dang sdang med tshangs par spyod pa yis/ /lus kyis bdag gzhan don 'grub byed pa dang*/ /gzugs rnams kun tu ston pa'i ting 'dzin dang*/ /kun nas snang ba'i gzungs la mkhas pa yis/ /thub pa'i sku gzugs sna tshogs kun ston pa/ /ye shes rjes 'brangs lus las bcu gsum pa/ /ye shes dbang gis sgyu sogs spangs pa'i ngag

| brdzun dang phra ma rtsub 'khyal rnam par spangs/ /phan dang ran dang chos kyi don ldan pas/ /bdag gzhan don grub byed dang rin po che'i/ /'byung gnas ting nge 'dzin dang 'khor gsum gyi/ /gzungs la mkhas pas brjod med mtshan nyid kyi/ /brjod pa kun ston kun tu 'jug pa yis/ /ye shes rjes 'brangs ngag las bcu bzhi pa/ /ye shes dbang gis sgyu sogs spangs pa'i yid | | brnab sems gnod sems log par lta bral zhing*/ /yang dag lta dang tshad med bzhi dang ni/ /brjod pa med pa'i byang chub sems ldan pa'i/ /rang gzhan las bsgrub da ltar byung ba yis/ /sangs rgyas mngon sum bzhugs pa'i ting 'dzin dang*/ /brnab sems rnyog pa med pa'i gzungs mkhas pa'i/ /spros pa med par 'gro ba'i yid shes shing*/ /mnyam pa nyid du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyi | | rjes su 'brang ba'i yid las bco lnga pa/ /phrin las kyis bsdus ∶pa'i (《 zha 》 pa yi )chos gsum mo/ /'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs rnams ye shes kyi | | chags med brnyes pa yid gnyis med pa yi/ /de yis sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa yi/ /lhun grub don kun bsgrub la mi skrag dang*/ /rang yang der mos gzhan dag der 'jug dang*/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang ni/ / gzi brjid ldan pa'i gzungs la mkhas pa yis/ /'das pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i/ /ye shes gzigs par 'jug pa bcu drug pa'o/ /ma 'ongs dus kyi rgyal ba'ang de lta bur/ /nges par shes shing rang yang der mos dang*/ / gzhan 'jug byed dang smon lam yang dag par/ /'phags pa'i ting 'dzin seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i/ /gzungs la mkhas pas ma 'ongs dus kun la/ /ma chags ye shes bcu bdun brnyes par 'gyur/ /de ltar zhugs pa'i rgyal ba'ang de lta bur/ /shes shing bdag mos gzhan yang der 'jug dang*/ /shin tu dkar ba dri med phyag rgya yis/ /ting nge 'dzin dang rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /gzungs la mkhas pas da ltar dus dag la/

/ma thogs ma chags ye shes gzigs pa gang | | 'jug par 'gyur 'di ma 'dres bco brgyad pa/ /de nas bu mo rin chen gyis sngon dag pa gang la zhugs nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis mngon par 'grub ces pa'i lan du/ dam bca' brtan pas zhabs mnyam pa/ /sna tshogs byin pas 'khor lo'i mtshan/ khyad du ma bsad rting pa yangs | | 'gro kun chos kyis bskyabs pa yis/ /sor mo ring dang gzhan bsdums pas/ /phyag zhabs dra bas 'brel pa dang*/ /gos byin pa yis gzhon sha can/ /bza' btung byin pas bdun mtho ba/ /chos bzung ba yis e n+ya'i byin | | gsang tshig sbas shing 'khrig pa'i chos/ /spangs pas sba ba sbubs su nub | | rgya chen dge bas seng ge'i stod/ /dge ba yang dag spyad pa yis/ /thal gong rab rgyas 'jigs pa las/ /dbugs phyung ba yis dpung mgo zlum/ / gzhan gyi don bsgrubs phyag ring dang*/ /dge bcus mi ngoms sku rnam dag / nad pa rnams la sman byin pas/ /mgrin pa dri med dung lta bu/ /dge ba'i sbyor tshogs seng ge'i 'gram/ /sems can sems mnyam tshems bzhi bcu/ /mi mthun mthun byas tshems thags bzang*/ /yid 'ong byin pas mnyam pa'i tshems | | sgo gsum bsrungs pas mche ba dkar/ /bden par smras pas ljags ring dang*/ /thags bzang byin pas ro bro'i mchog /tshig sdom snyan par smras pa yis | | tshangs dbyangs ka la liṅka'i dbyangs/ /byams pas gzhan don mthon mthing spyan/ /sgyu med ba yi rdzi ma dang*/ /bsngags 'os bsngags pas mdzod spu dkar | | bla mar gus pas gtsug tor mchog /sems las rung bas pags pa srab | | mal stan byin pas gser mdog dang*/ /'du 'dzi spangs pas mdzod spu mdzes | | gdams pa rjes su mthun bzung bas/ /ba spu'i rtse mo g.yas su 'khyil | | brdeg btsog spangs pas dbu skra mthing*/ /gzhan dag ting 'dzin la sbyar bas/ /n+ya gro dha ltar chu zheng gab/ /sku gzugs mchod rten bcos pa dang | | 'jigs las gzhan dag dbugs phyung dang*/

/nyam chung bde la bkod pa yis/ /stobs po che yi mchog tu 'gyur/ /de nas bu mos yon tan de dag bsgrub pa thun mong gi rgyu byang chub sems dpa'i chos dang chos spyod pa'i tshul zhus shing rgyas par gsungs te/ bsdu ba'i skabs su bu mo byang chub sems dpa' gang 'di lta bur chos thams cad khong du chud nas/ sems can gzhan dag 'dul ba'i phyir/ 'khor ba na'ang spyod la/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos nyid las kyang mi g.yo ba 'di ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yang dag pa'i phul yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas shā ri'i bus dris pa'i lan du/ bu mos byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la rgyas 'debs pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i phyag rgya bshad nas/ lam dang 'bras bu thun mong gi tshul rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ bu mos ci'i slad du/ theg pa 'di ni theg pa chen po zhes bgyi/ zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis theg pa 'di ni sems can thams cad la skabs 'byed pa rgya che ba'o/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa che ba'i tshul lnga bcu rtsa drug gis theg pa chen po'i chos kyi che ba gsungs nas/ slar yang bu mo rin chen gyis theg pa chen po la bar du gcod par 'gyur ba'i chos du mchis zhes zhus pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bar du gcod pa'i chos sum cu rtsa gnyis gsungs pa ni 'di lta ste/ nyan thos rang rgyal brgya byin sogs 'dod dang*/ /skye la gnas 'dun tshangs par spyod pa dang*/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshul gcig la chags dang*/ /longs spyod chags dang sems can mnyam mi sbyin/ /tshul khrims lhod dang byang sems mi bsrung dang*/ /gnod sems khong khro'i bag chags kyis bsgos dang*/ /zhum dang brjed ngas thob (《 zha 》 thos )pa don mi gnyer/ /spyod pa med dang 'phags min tshul gnas dang*/ /nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal 'phel ba dang | | lus ngag sems las yongs su ma dag dang*/ /dam chos mi bsrung dpe mkhyud byed pa dang*/

/bsdu dngos 'dor dang dgar 'gyur chos gtong dang*/ / sdig grogs brten dang byang chub mi bsngo dang*/ /dge ba chung ngus rlom sems byed pa dang*/ /thabs med blo dang dkon mchog mi bsngags dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' la ni gnod sems dang*/ /ma thos chos spang bdud las mi shes dang | | rgyang 'phen pa yi gsang tshig 'dzin pa dang*/ /sems can smin par mi byed 'khor ba yi/ /yongs su skyo ba 'di ni sum cu gnyis/ /zhes gsungs nas/ bar du gcod pa de dag sel bar byed pa theg pa chen po rnam par dag par 'gyur ba'i chos kyang sum cu rtsa gnyis gsungs pa/ 'di lta ste/ /gsol ba ma btab sems can bshes 'gyur dang*/ /'jig rten 'du 'dzi byed la dga' med dang*/ /dge ba'i tshogs la bsam pa brtan pa dang*/ /zhum pa med dang rnyog pa med sems dang*/ /spyod lam rnam mi rtog pas lus dag dang*/ /ji skad smras bzhin byed pas ngag dag dang*/ /byang chub sems mi 'dor bas sems dag dang*/ /lan la mi re ba yi sbyin pa dag /bslab pa 'chal pa skyob pas tshul khrims dag /lus srog mi lta ba yi bzod pa dag /mi 'jigs stobs rdzogs byed pas brtson 'grus dag /nyon mongs zil gyis gnon pas bsam gtan dag /bag chags yang dag 'joms pas shes rab dag /bdud las yongs su spangs pas sems pa dang*/ kha 'og lus 'grub byed pas yi dam brtan | | 'gro smin byed pas bsdu dngos mi 'dor dang*/ /dam chos bsrungs pas thub la byas pa bzo/ /byang chub chos rdzogs byed pas mi skyo dang*/ /shes rab ∶zab mo (《 zha 》 ye shes )yongs su rdzogs byed pas/ /thos pas mi ngoms pa dang gong ma'i tshul/ /shes pas rang gi gnas la mi chags dang*/ /gtsug tor bltar mi mthong bar bya ba'i phyir/ /nga rgyal med pa'i sems kyis nyan pa dang | | rgyu rkyen shes pas chos dang 'gal med dang*/ /nor bdun thob phyir dbul ba med pa dang*/ /rang dbang thob pas gzhan dbang ma gyur dang*/

/ tshogs kyi bsgrub pas nyon mongs zhi byed pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rig pa bsgrub pa yis/ /zhi gnas tshogs dang rnam grol bsgrub pa yis/ /lhag mthong tshogs dang sgo gsum bsgom pa yis/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo mo 'byed pa dang | | sems can ji snyed pa yi khong chud pas/ /nad zhi ba dang mi skye chos bzod pas/ /zad dang skye ba med pa shes pa dang*/ /chos la nan tan lhur byed lung ston pa/ /'di dag rnam par dag byed sum cu gnyis/ /zhes gsungs nas mthar brgya byin la sogs pa la yongs su gtad de/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yang rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /de ltar theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi /mdo sde bsdus te bshad pa'i dge ba yis/ /'gro kun theg pa chen po'i lam zhugs nas/ / theg chen 'bras bu'i dpal gyis 'byor gyur cig /theg pa chen po'i man ngag ces bya ba/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo'i don yang dag par bsdus pa 'phags pas dpal sa skyar me mo glang gi lo/ dbyar zla 'bring po la myur du bris pa'o// //༄༅/ /∶snying po'i sdom zhes bya ba (《 zha 》 mdo lnga'i dang po de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i sa bcad/ )bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /snying po'i sdom zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying po yongs su sbyang ba gang zhig gis | | snying po mngon du mdzad la phyag 'tshal nas/ /snying po ston par byed pa mdo sde'i sdom/ /snying po gsal bar bya phyir bdag gis bshad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa'i mdo sde la don gsum/ gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas chos ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ gang gsungs pa'i chos phun sum tshogs pa dngos/ mjug 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rjes su yi rang bas gzhung rdzogs par bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ gang gis ji ltar gleng bslang ba dang*/ gleng ba'i chos dngos so/ /dang po la gnyis/ ston pas gleng bslang ba dang*/

'khor gyis gleng ba bslang ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ chos gsungs pa'i don du rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa dang*/ zhu ba po'i spro ba bskyed pa'o/ /de la gnyis/ gang la spobs pa bskyed par bya ba'i yul ngos gzung ba dang*/ gang gis ji ltar spobs pa bskyed pa'o/ /'khor gyis gleng bslang ba la gnyis/ 'khor gyi the tshom bsal ba'i phyir rdzu 'phrul ston pa'i rgyu mtshan zhu ba dngos dang*/ de nyid tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bzlas te zhus pa'o/ /gnyis pa gleng ba'i chos dngos la gnyis/ bshad par dam bca' zhing mnyan par gdams pa dang*/ don dngos so/ /de la gnyis/ 'khor rnams gus pas nyan pa'i tshul dang*/ ston pas ji ltar gsungs pa'i chos so/ /de la gnyis | sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yod kyang mi mthong bas dpe dgu bstan pa dang*/ chos nyid la mos pa dang*/ bzung ba'i yon tan bstan pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ so so skye bo la ∶gzhi smras (《 zha 》 sgrib ) pa'i dpe/ nyan thos la sgrib pa'i dpe/ slob pa la sgrib pa'i dpe/ byang chub sems dpa' la sgrib pa'i dpe'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ 'dod chags kyi bag la nyal pad+ma'i 'dab ma dang*/ zhe sdang gi bag la nyal bung ba dang*/ gti mug gi bag la nyal ∶sbrang bu (《 zha 》 sbun pa )dang 'dra la nyon mongs pa'i kun nas ldang ba mi gtsang ba dang 'dra ba'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ mthong spang gi sgrib pas sa bon gyi shun pa dang 'dra ba'o/ /sgom spang gi dri ma gos rdul dang 'dra ba'o | | bzhi pa la gnyis/ ma dag pa'i sa bdun la brten pa'i sgrib pa mngal gyi dri ma dang 'dra ba dang*/ dag pa'i sa gsum la brten pa'i sgrib pa 'jim pa dang 'dra ba'o/ /don gnyis pa chos 'di la mos shing 'dzin pa'i phan yon la gsum | bsod nams rgya che bar bskyed pa/ tshegs chung ngus 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur la/ las dang po pas ji ltar bsgom pa'i tshul phan yon dang bcas pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/

bsod nams ji tsam 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang | de nges par bya ba'i phyir sngon byung ba'i rabs bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis | dge ba gzhan zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ de nyid tshigs su bcad pas bzlas te gsungs pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rdzu 'phrul gyi sangs rgyas mang po mchod pa'i dge ba zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ chos 'di la yi rang tsam gyis kyang rdzu 'phrul la ma brten par sangs rgyas mchod pa'i dge ba zil gyis gnon pa'o | | gnyisapa de nges par bya ba'i phyir sngon byung ba'i rabs bstan pa la gnyis | zhu ba po rdo rje blo gros kyis sngon chos 'di gang las rnyed pa dang*/ de nyid tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bzlas te gsungs pa'o/ /de la gnyis/ zhu ba po'i sngon rabs dang*/ ston pa nyid kyis thog mar gang las rnyed pa gsungs pa'o/ /gnyis pa tshegs chung ngus 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba la gnyis/ las kyi sgrib pas bsgribs kyang tshegs chung ngus don rtogs par 'gyur ba dang*/ sgrib pas ma bsgribs pa chos 'di'i snod du 'gyur ba'i rgyu bstan pa'o/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i sdom/ /bris pa'i dge ba gang des 'gro kun gyi | | rang gi khams kyi dri ma yongs su sbyangs nas/ /rtogs pa'i chos sku mngon du 'gyur bar shog /snying po'i sdom zhes bya ba dge slong 'phags pas me mo glang gi lo ston zla ra ba la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por bshad pa'i tshe sbyar ba 'di rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /(《 zha 》+ gsang chen )thabs la mkhas pa'i ∶sdom zhes bya ba (《 zha 》 sa bcad )bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i sdom zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig thabs la mkhas pas rang gi don/ /phun tshogs brnyes nas gzhan don lhun grub pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la btud nas de yi gsung*/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i sdom 'di bshad par bya/ /de la gsum/ gleng gzhi'i chos ji ltar byung ba'i tshul bstan pa/

gang gsungs pa'i mdo gzhung dngos/ mjug 'khor rnams rjes su yi rang bas gzhung rnams rdzogs par bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ zhus pa dang lan no | | dang po la gsum/ skabs dbye bar zhu ba dang*/ ston pas skabs gnang ba ji ltar zhus pa'i tshul lo/ /lan la gnyis/ mnyan par gdams pa dang*/ don dngos so/ /de la gnyis/ thabs la mkhas pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs dngos dang*/ de gzung ba'i phan yon no/ /dang po la gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis | byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i mchog gzhan dang*/ stong pa nyid byang chub sems dpa'i dus kyi thabs la mkhas pa bstan pas 'phags pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'o/ / dang po la dgu/ sbyin pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ bdag pos ma bzung ba'i mchod pa/ sems can la dmigs pa/ sangs rgyas la dmigs pa/ bdag nyid la dmigs pa/ gnyis ka la dmigs pa/ sbyin pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug rdzogs par 'gyur ba/ tshul khrims kyi thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /bzhi pa la gnyis/ sems can sdug bsngal ba la dmigs pa dang | bde ba la dmigs pa'o/ /bdag nyid la (《

zha 》+ dmigs la )gnyis/ blo rtul bas ji ltar bya ba dang*/ dbul pos ji ltar bya ba'o/ /tshul khrims kyi thabs la mkhas pa la gnyis/ nyes ltung bshags pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang | byang chub sems dpa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba ches che ba ngos bzung zhing de spang ba'i thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'phags pa'i thabs la mkhas pa la gnyis | byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i rtog pa brjod pa rnams dang dpe rnams kyi rlabs po che'i thabs la mkhas pa bstan pa dang*/ thub pa nyid byang chub sems dpa'i dus ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul bstan pas skye ba gcig gis thogs pa dang*/ srid pa tha ma pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /dang po la bdun/ 'dod pa'i bde bas mi gos pa'i thabs la mkhas pa gnyis skur pa sel ba'i thabs la mkhas pa dge slong dri med kyi rnam thar/ thabs la mkhas pas 'dod pa bsten kyang nyes par mi 'gyur ba dpe sna tshogs kyis bstan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' la chags pa'ang don du 'gyur ba dge slong dga' byed kyi rnam par thar pa bstan pa/ thabs la mkhas pa rtogs pa'i g.yeng ba mang po byang chub kyi sems gcig tu bsgyur ba'i ri rab kyi dpes bstan pa/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa thabs la mkhas pa gcig gis sel ba sman lta mdzes kyi dpes bstan pa/ rang nyid srid zhi'i mthar mi ltung zhing gzhan 'dren pa'i thabs la mkhas pa 'brog dang grong gi dpes bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ tshogs can rab mchog rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa dang*/ bram ze'i khye'u skar ma'i rnam par thar pa'o/ /tshogs can rab mchog gi rnam par thar pa la drug kun dga' bos glengs pa/ tshogs can rab mchog gis rdzu 'phrul bstan pa/ kun dga' bos nongs pa bshags pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i thabs la mkhas pa rgyas par gsungs pa/ tshogs can rab mchog rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis slar rjes su bsngags pa'o/ /dpe sna tshogs kyis bstan pa la drug sbrul 'tshong ma/ mes gdungs pa'i sa bon/

bung ba/ nya pa | sngags 'chang ba/ 'phong gi slob dpon gyi dpe'o/ /thub pa nyid byang chub sems dpa'i dus su ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul bstan pa la gnyis/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ srid pa tha ma pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'o | | dang po la gsum/ byang chub sems dpa' thabs la mkhas shing gnod pa spang ba bstan pa dang*/ de la rtsod pa spang ba dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa dngos rgyu mtshan dang bcas par bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rtsod pa dang lan no | | de la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum | dus la dbang 'byor ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor ba dang*/ skye ba la dbang 'byor pa thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /de la gsum/ dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'phos pa/ lhums su 'jug pa/ lhums na gnas pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /srid pa tha ma pa'i thabs la mkhas pa la bdun/ lhums nas bltams pa/ gzhon nu'i rol rtsed/ btsun mo'i 'khor bstan pa/ khab nas 'byung ba/ dka' ba spyad pa/ byang chub snying por gshegs pa/ bdud kyi sde bcom pa'o/ dang po la lnga/ mngal nas 'byung ba'i 'thad pa/ gang du 'byung ba'i gnas/ ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ gang nas byung ba'i tshul/ de ltar byung ma thag gi mdzad pa'o/ /de la bzhi/ zhabs 'bring ba/ sku'i kun tu spyod pa/ gtso bor zhal gyis bzhes pa dang bzhad pa gnyis kyis gsung gi kun tu spyod pa/ 'jig rten pa'i tshul dang bstun pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ rol rtsed la 'jug pa'i 'thad pa dang*/ yum gyi sku tshe mkhyen pa dang*/ rol rtsed dngos kyi thabs la mkhas pa'o/ /bzhi pa la gsum/ khab nas 'byung ba dngos/ 'byor pa don du mi gnyer bar bstan pa/ bdag nyid kyis dbu skra bzhar ba'i 'thad pa'o | | lnga pa la gnyis/ dang po zas mi gsol ba'i dgos pa dang*/ phyis gsol ba'i 'thad pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i thabs la mkhas pa la gsum | byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba/

las kyi rgyu ba bstan pa'o/ /de la bzhi/ de bzhin gshegs pa las kyi sgrib pa las grol bar bstan pa/ slob dpon sman pa/ ma ma'i dpe gsum gyis de nges par bya ba'i sgrib pa las grol yang las la spyod pa'i tshul rgyas par bstan pa/ mjug bsdu ba'o/ /gsum pa la bcu/ srog gcod pa'i las kyi rgyu ba | sman gsol ba/ bsod snyoms ma rnyed pa/ skur pa thob pa/ gzhan gyi gnod pa sel ba btang snyoms su mdzad pa/ rta chas gsol ba/ sku rgyab bsnyung bar bstan pa/ klad pa bsnyung bar bstan pa/ sbyor ba dang du bzhes pa/ lha sbyin yang yang rjes su 'brang bar bstan pa'o/ /de gzung ba'i phan yon la gsum | don gsal bar gdams pa/ 'di'i don shes pa'i phan yon dang*/ tshig thos pa'i phan yon la gnyis kyi phan yon dngos dang*/ ming gi rnam grangs so | | de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gsang*/ /gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i sdom | | sdom brtson 'phags pas gsal bar bstan/ /bstan pas 'gro kun kun mkhyen shog /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo'i don bsdus pa 'di ni bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho'i bang mdzod bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po rin po che de nyid kyi zhal snga nas phal cher rdzogs pa zhig yi gair bkod la/ mjug cung zad ma bris pa ni de nyid kyi gsung la zin ris bgy-is pa zhig las bris pa'o// //༄༅/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi ∶sdom (《 zha 》 rgyal po'i sa bcad )bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi sdom zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ting 'dzin brtson pas ting 'dzin mchog brnyes nas/ /ting 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa kun 'phrul zhing*/ /'gro la ting 'dzin zhi ba rab ston pa/ /ting 'dzin dbang phyug dpal la phyag 'tshal lo | | ting 'dzin mchog mang gsungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /ston par byed pa ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo/ /bsdus pa'i sdom gyis gsal bar bstan pa 'di//

blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal gyis bshad par bya/ /de la gsum/ gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pas mdo sde ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul/ gang bshad pa'i chos phun sum tshogs pas mdo sde'i gzhung dngos/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyis mngon par bstod pas yongs su rdzogs par bstan pa'o/ /de la dang po ni gleng gzhi'i le'u'o | | gnyis pa ni sangs rgyas sā la'i dbang po'i le'u/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i le'u/ ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ sangs rgyas dbyangs byin gyi le'u/ ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyang ba'i le'u/ bzod pa gsum gyi le'u/ sangs rgyas dngos po med pa las byung ba'i le'u/ chos zab mo la bzod pa'i le'u/ grong khyer du gshegs pa'i le'u/ mdo sde 'dzin pa'i le'u/ ting nge 'dzin rjes su slob pa'i le'u | ting nge 'dzin nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ 'dzum pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 'dzum pa lung bstan pa'i le'u/ sngon byung gi le'u/ sangs rgyas mang po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo'i le'u/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su ting nge 'dzin 'dzin pa dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ rgyas par rjes su gtad pa'i le'u/ dri za zur phud lnga pa'i pi wang gi sgras/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rjes su bsgrags pas byin gyis brlabs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ de rnams kyi thog mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i tshul bstan nas/ sangs rgyas dbang po'i tog gi rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po'i le'u/ chos smra ba rnams la ting nge 'dzin bstan pa dang*/ sngon byung ba'i le'u/ lus la chags pa'i gnas ma yin pa nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi skur mi lta zhing*/ chos kyi skur nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i le'u/ so so yang dag par rig pa la 'jug pa'i le'u/ rjes su yi rang ba'i le'u/

sbyin pa'i le'u | tshul khrims nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ phan yon bcu'i le'u/ gzi brjid tshogs kyi rgyal po'i (《 zha 》+ le'u )phan yon gyi le'u ste bcu gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag go /chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nges par bstan pa'i le'u ting nge 'dzin gyi dngos gzhi'o/ /mdo sde 'dzin pa'i phan yon gyi le'u phan yon dngos so/ /dge slong bde bas byin pa'i le'u/ bu mo ye shes ldan gyi le'u/ me tog zla mdzes kyi le'u/ gsum ni sngaun byung gi tshul gyi nges byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi phan yon dang*/ gzungs kyi phan yon bstan pa ni phan yon rgyas bshad do/ /snyan pa'i 'od kyi le'u ni nges byed do/ /mjug bsdu ba'i le'u gsum gyis tshul khrims rgyas bshad do/ /sgo gsum gyi mtshams sbyor tshig nyis brgya dgu bcu rtsa bdun cung zad bshad de/ lus kyi sdom pa'i phan yon gyi le'u/ ngag gi sdom pa'i phan yon gyi le'u/ /yid kyi sdom pa'i phan yon gyi le'u/ mjug bsdu ba'i phan yon gyi le'u rnams so/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i bsdus pa'i don gyi tho yig go /'di bas bsdus don shin tu zab pa zhig gsungs mod kyis yi ger ma mdzad la/ zin ris kyang ma grub cing ma mthong la 'di tsam zhig brtsam gzhi la snang ngo*// //༄༅/ /∶byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i sdom (《 zha 》 sa bcu pa'i sa bcad )bzhugs// ༄༅/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i sdom zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi spyod pa dpag yas pa/ /dpag med 'gro ba'i ded dpon mchog /rgyal sras rnams la phyag 'tshal te/ /de yi sa bcu rnam par dbye/ /sangs rgyas phal po che las/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdo tsam bstan pa'i mdo sde sa bcu pa la don gsum/ gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pas byung tshul nges par bya ba/ gang bshad par bya ba'i chos phun sum tshogs pas mdo nyid rgyas par bstan pa/

mjug ston pas dges shing 'khor gyis mngon par bstod pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ chos phun sum tshogs par bstan pa dang*/ ston pa/ dus/ gnas/ 'khor phun sum tshogs ∶pa (《 zha 》 pas de )nges par bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa la lnga/ thugs dang*/ gsung dang*/ skus sangs rgyas kyi ston par byin gyis brlabs pa dpes mdo tsam bstan pa/ bstan pa'i don rgya cher zhus pa/ zhus pa'i don rgyas par bshad pa | bshad pa'i don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ don la nges pa bskyed pa'i phyir sa'i che ba bstan pa dang*/ tshig la nges pa bskyed pa'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung bar bstan pa'o/ gsum pa la lnga/ zhu ba'i rgyu mtshan/ zhu ba dngos/ rgyas par mi gsung ba'i rgyu mtshan/ snod skyon med du bsgrubs nas slar yang zhus pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis bskul ba'o | | zhus pa'i don rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ mnyan par gdams pa dang | don dngos so/ /de la bcu/ sa'i don rgyas par bstan pa dang*/ de dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i tshul gyi bsdus te bstan pa de gnyis kyis/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba/ gnyis pa dri ma med pa/ gsum pa 'od byed pa/ bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba/ lnga pa sbyang dka' ba/ drug pa mngon du gyur pa/ bdun pa ring du song ba | brgyad pa mi g.yo ba/ dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/ bcu pa chos kyi sprin no | | sa dang po la ni spyi'i zhu ba byas ma thag yin pa'i phyir/ khyad par gyi zhu ba ma gsungs pas/ sa de'i don rgyas par bstan pa dang*/ de dbyangs kyis bsnyad de bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa nas dgu pa'i bar gyi re re la'ang*/ sa de khyad par du zhus pa dang*/ zhus pa'i don rgyas pa bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa'i don dbyangs kyis bsnyad pas bsdu ba ste/ re re la'ang gsum gsum mo/ /sa bcu pa'i bsdu ba 'og nas bstan pas/ sa de khyad par du zhu ba dang*/ zhus pa'i don rgyas par bstan pa gnyis so/ /lnga pa sa thams cad kyi 'jug bsdu ba la gnyis/

rkang pas bshad pa dang*/ de dbyangs kyis bsnyad de bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ sa'i che ba/ che ba can thos par dka' ba/ thos nas phan yon che ba/ de nyid nges pa'i don du cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ don dang dpes sa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa mdor bstan pa dang*/ sa bcu'i yon tan rim pa bcu dang sbyar ba dang*/ rgya mtsho'i chos bcu dang sbyar ba dang*/ sa'i yon tan thun mong du rin po che'i chos bcu la sbyar ba dang*/ gsum gyis rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dbyangs kyis bsnyad de bsdu ba la gsum/ ched du bya ba dang*/ che ba dngos dang*/ de nges par bya ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ dang po/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa/ lnga pa/ drug pa/ bdun pa/ brgyad pa/ dgu pa rnams kyi sa dgu so so'i bsdu ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba rgya che ba/ rtogs pa rgya che ba/ rdzu 'phrul rgya che ba/ thos pa rgya che ba/ spyod pa rgya che ba/ ston pa rgya che ba ste drug gis sa bcu pa rgya cher bsdu ba'o/ /de nges par bya ba la gsum/ ri dang*/ rgya mtsho dang*/ rin po che'i dpe gsum la sbyar ba'o/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i sa/ /sa ltar rgya che bcu ru bstan/ /bstan pa ji bzhin bla mas gsungs// gsungs pa ji ltar zin bzhin bris/ /de las dge ba gang bskrun des/ /rgyal sras spyod bzhin legs spyad nas/ /kun mkhyen kun dga'i khang bzangs su/ / gegs med par ni 'jug gyur cig /de ltar mdo sde sa bcu pa'i sdom 'di ni/ bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po rin po ches me mo glang gi lo ston zla 'bring po la dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sde snod 'dzin pa du ma'i dbus su gsal bar gsungs shing*/ de'i gsung de ma thag tu ji ltar zin pa bzhin btsun pa ston gzhon gyis zin bris byas te slar yang phyag tu phul nas dag par bgyis so || || ༄༅/ /sangs rgyas kyi sa'i ∶sdom zhes bya ba (《 zha 》 sa bcad )bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sdom zhes bya ba/

sangs rgyas dang bya chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas snying po sangs rgyas lam gyis ni/ /rab tu sbyangs pas sangs rgyas nyid rnyed pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal rdzogs sangs rgyas de'i gsung*/ /sangs rgyas sa yi bsdus don 'dir bshad bya/ /de la gsum/ gleng gzhi'i sgo nas mdo ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ gleng ba'i sgo nas mdo'i rang bzhin rnam par dgod pa/ 'khor gyis mngon par bstod pa'i sgo nas/ mdo yongs su rdzogs par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ phum sum tshogs pa lngas mdor bstan pa dang*/ gnas dang*/ ston pa dang*/ 'khor gyis rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'khor rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ nyan thos kyi 'khor dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor ro/ /gnyis pa gleng ba mdo'i rang bzhin la gsum/ ye shes lnga'i sgo nas mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa | brten pa ye shes lnga dang*/ rten sku gsum gyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ chos kyi dbyings/ me long lta bu/ mnyam pa nyid/ so sor rtog pa/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te lngas ye shes lnga so so'i rang bzhin dang*/ de la the tshom gyi gnas zhus lan gyis gtan la dbab pa'o/ /de la gsum/ zhus pa

| lan/ lan gyi don nges pa'i phyir slar yang zhus pa'o/ /de la gsum/ zhus pa | lan/ de nges pa'i don du dpe dang sbyar bar zhus pa'o/ /de la gnyis/ zhus pa dang 'dres pa'i tshul dang*/ chu klung gi dpe gnyis kyis lan no/ /de ltar sangs rgyas sa yi sdom/ /de tsam bsdus pa'i sdom 'di yang*/ /yang dag sbyar bas 'gro ba kun/ /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par shog /sangs rgyas sa'i sdom zhes bya ba dge slong 'phags pas me mo glang gi lo ston zla 'bring po la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por bshad pa'i tshe sbyar ba'o/ /de ltar mdo lnga po yang dang po ni rgyu/ bar pa gsum ni lam/ tha ma ni 'bras bu'o/ /lam yang dang po ni thabs so/ /gnyis pa ni shes rab bo/ /gsum pa ni de nyid kyi bgrod pa'i tshul lo/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab zab mo'i mdo lnga'i bsdus pa'i sdom rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi bsdus don bzhugs// ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang | | yon tan phrin las gang gis gsal mdzad pa'i/ /mgon po de la gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi gsung gi bsdus don bri bar bya/ /de la theg pa chen po'i rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos 'di la don gnyis/ brtsam par bya ba gzhung gi don dang*/ mthar phyin pa mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gsum/ bstan bcos lus kyi brjod bya bsdu ba/ go rim mdo dang mthun pa/ de'i 'brel rnam par bzhag pa gsum gyis/ lus rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ yan lag rgyas par dbye ba'o/ /de la gnyis/ 'bras bu dkon mchog gi rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ rgyu dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum so so'i rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ thun mong gi rnam gzhag go | dang po la gsum/ sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin rnam par bzhag pa/ de nyid kyi don bsdu ba/ rgyas par bshad pa gsum gyi sangs rgyas dkon mchog

chos kyi rang bzhin rnam par bzhag pa/ de nyid kyi don bsdu ba/ rgyas par bshad pa gsum gyis chos dkon mchog phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun gyi rang bzhin rnam par bzhag pa/ de nyid kyi don bsdu ba/ rgyas par bshad pa gsum gyis dge 'dun dkon mchog thun mong gi rnam par bzhag pa la gsum/ skyabs gsum du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan/ chos dang dge 'dun kun rdzob kyi skyabs su bstan pa dang | sangs rgyas don dam pa'i skyabs su bstan pa gnyis kyis skyabs kyi khyad par bzhag pa/ dkon mchog rin po che dang 'dra bar bstan pas ming gi don nges par bya ba'o/ /don gnyis pa rgyu dkon mchog gi rigs rnam par bzhag pa la gnyis/ rnam gzhag dngos dang*/ de la mos pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po la gnyis | rigs kyi don mdor bstan pa/ de nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pas sangs rgyas kyi yul du bstan pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don rgyas par bshad pa | de rnams rgyu dang rkyen du bzhag pa bzhis dkon mchog gi rigs spy-i'i rnam gzhag dang*/ so so'i rnam gzhag go /de la bzhi/ khams rang bzhin gyi dag pa/ dri ma med pa'i byang chub/ dbyer med pa'i yon tan/ mdzad pa phrin las so/ / dang po la gnyis/ drang don gyi dbang du byas te khams rnam dag yod par gtan la dbab pa dang*/ nges don gyi dbang du byas te/ de nyid dgongs pa can du bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ khams yod pa'i sgrub byed dgod pa/ khams de'i rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa/ yod kyang mi mthong bar bstan pa'o/ / gnyis pa la gnyis/ sdom gyi mdor bstan pa dang*/ don dbye bas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ de la bdun/ ngo bo dang rgyu'i don/ 'bras bu dang las kyi don/ ldan pa'i grogs/ dbye ba'i don/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis kyis kun tu 'gro ba/ 'gyur ba med pa/ dbyer med pa'i don no/ /dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad do/ /de la gnyis/ ngo bo rgyas par bshad pa/

sgrib pa bzhi'i gnyen por rgyu bzhi bstan pa dang*/ rgyu bzhi dang ldan pas thub pa'i sras su bstan pa gnyis kyis rgyu'i don rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'bras bu dang las kyi don la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad do/ /'bras bu rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/gnyen pos phye ba'i 'bras bu bzhi bstan pa dang*/ yon tan bzhi po gtan la dbab pa gnyis kyis chos kyi sku yon tan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bzhir bstan pa dang*/ shes rab snying rje mthar phyin pas mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa bstan pa'o/ /skye ba dang 'dun pa'i las dang ldan pa dang*/ las dang rigs kyi sgrub byed du bstan pa gnyis kyi las rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /ldan pa'i grogs la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyu'i ldan pa dang 'bras bu'i ldan pa gnyis kyis rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dbye ba'i don la gnyis/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis kyis 'jug par dbye ba dang*/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis kyis gnas skabs kyi dbye ba'o/ /'gyur ba med pa'i don la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad do/ /de la gsum/ ma dag pa'i gnas skabs/ dag pa dang ma dag pa'i gnas skabs/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gnas skabs su 'gyur ba med pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ 'gyur ba med pa nam mkha'i dpes bstan pa/ rkyen gyi skye 'jig tu mi 'gyur ba dang*/ 'jig rkyen gsum gyis mi 'jig par brtan pa gnyis kyi skye 'jig med pa bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ rgyas par bstan pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la lnga/ rang dri mas ma gos pa/ gzhan skye 'jig gi gzhi yin pa/ rkyen gyis 'jig par mi 'gyur ba/ dpe dang don dang phan tshun sbyar ba gsum gyi rten gnas med pa/ rgyu rkyen gyis skye 'jig med pa'o/ /dag pa dang ma dag pa'i gnas skabs su 'gyur ba med pa la gsum/ mdor bstan pa dang dag pa dang ma dag pa'i don bshad pa gnyis kyis rgyas bshad/ shin tu rgyas par bshad pa'o/

/de la bzhi/ mdo rgyas gnyis kyi sems dang po bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dpe don gnyis kyi spyod pa la zhugs pa'i skabs/ phyir mi ldog pa'i skabs/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i skabs so/ /de la gnyis/ dag pa dang ma dag pa gnyis kyis rang bzhin gyi don bsgrub pa dang*/ mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa'i khyad par ro/ shin tu rnam par dag pa'i skabs su 'gyur ba med pa la gsum/ 'gyur med kyi don bzhi mdor bstan pa/ de nyid kyi phyir skye 'chi na rga las grol ba dang*/ de dag gi don bsdu ba gnyis kyis rgyas bshad/ shin tu rgyas bshad do/ /dbye ba med pa'i don la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas bshad do/ /de la gnyis/ ming gi rnam grangs bzhir bstan pa/ der 'jog pa'i don bstan pa gnyis kyis gang dang dbyer med pa zag med kyi dbyings dang*/ gang dbyer med pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /de la gsum/ sangs rgyas dang mya ngan las 'das pa dbyer med pa/ de nyid nyi ma dang mtshungs par bstan pa/ des na sangs rgyas las gzhan du mya ngan las 'das pa med par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang | rgyas bshad do/ de la gnyis/ yon tan bzhi ldan gyi sangs rgyas nyid thar par bstan pa/ ri mo mkhan gyi dpe dang*/ don la sbyar ba gnyis kyis yon tan thams cad bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /don gnyis pa yod kyang mi mthong ba bstan pa la gsum/ rkyen gang gis mi mthong ba dpes bstan pa/ gang zag gang gis mi mthong ba de 'jug tshul dang bcas pa/ gsal bzhag dang bral ba/ sgro skur dang bral ba gnyis kyis/ gang mi mthong ba'i don bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mtshams sbyar gyi tshul gyi dpes rtogs byar bstan pa dang*/ dpe don rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gnyis/ sgrib byed dang*/ bsgrib bya dpe don sbyar te bstan pa dang*/ sgrib byed dang bsgrib bya so sor gtan la dbab pa'o/ / dang po la gsum/ dpe don so sor bstan pas mdor bstan/

phan tshun sbyar bas rgyas bshad/ de dag gi don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dpe dgu dang*/ don bstan pa gnyis kyis dpe don rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ de nyid kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa phan tshun sbyar ba la dgu/ pad+mas rgyal ba'i sku sgrib pa dang 'dra bar/ sbrang bus sbrang rtsi/ sbun pas 'bru/ mi gtsang bas gser/ sas gter | sa bon gyis myu gu/ gos hrul gyis rgyal ba'i sku/ mngal gyis mi bdaga'adam pas gser gyi sku bsgribs pa dang 'dra bar bstan pa'o/ /de dag re re la'ang dpe bstan pa/ don bstan pa/ dpe don sbyar ba gsum gsum gyis rigs par bya'o/ /de dag gi don bsdu ba la gnyis/ sgrib byed kyi dpe dang*/ bsgrib bya'i dpe gnyis kyis dpe bsdu ba dang*/ don bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa bsgrib byed dang*/ bsgrib bya so sor bstan pa la gnyis/ sgrib byed ∶dri ma'i (《 zha 》 mi 'dra ba'i )rnam gzhag bsgrib bya don gyi rnam gzhag go /dang po la gsum/ sgrib byed kyi don 'dod chags la sogs pa dgur bstan pa dang*/ pad+ma la sogs pa'i dpe dang mtshungs par bzhag pa gnyis kyis gang gis bsgrib pa'i dri ma | gang la bsgrib pa'i gang zag sgrib byed kyi dpe don chos mthun bstan pa'o | | de la gnyis/ bag la nyal gyi 'dod chags dang pad+ma mtshungs pa/ zhe sdang dang sbrang bu/ gti mug dang sbun pa/ nyon mongs pa kun ldang dang mi gtsang ba | bag chags dang sa/ mthong spang dang sa bon/ bsgom spang dang gos hrul/ ma dag pa la brten pa'i dri ma dang mngal/ dag pa la brten pa'i dri ma dang*/∶'dam mtshungs par (《 zha 》 dag pa brten pa'i dri ma 'dam pa )bstan pa dgus dpe don chos mthun rgyas par bshad pa/ de nyid kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /bsgrib bya don gyi rnam gzhag la gsum/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ shin tu rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum/ chos kyi sku gsum du dbye ba dang*/ dpe gsum dang mtshungs par bstan pa gnyis kyis chos sku/

de bzhin nyid gser dang mtshungs pa | rang bzhin dang*/ rgyas pa'i rigs gter dang ljon shing dang mtshungs pa dang | de las grub pa'i sku gsum dpe lhag ma gsum dang mtshungs pa gnyis kyis rigs dpe lnga dang mtshungs pa'o/ /don gnyis pa nges don gyi dbang du byas te/ de nyid dgongs pa can du bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad do/ /de la gnyis/ chos thams cad stong par bstan pas dngos la gnod byed dgongs te gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /de la gnyis/ nyes pa lnga spangs pa'i dgos pa mdor bstan pa dang*/ de nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum/ sems zhum pa/ sems can dman pa la brnyas pa/ yang dag mi 'dzin pa/ yang dag pa la skur ba/ bdag la chags pa ste lngas bsal bya'i skyon/ sel byed kyi rkyen/ bsal bya'i phan yon/ don la gnyis/ dri ma med pa'i byang chub pa la gnyis/ sdom gyi mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la lnga | ngo bo dang rgyu'i don/ 'bras bu'i don/ las kyi don/ ldan pa'i grogs/ 'jug pa'i don no/ /dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o | | de la gnyis/ ngo bo rgyas bshad dang*/ rgyu rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dpe'i sgo nas mdor bstan rang bzhin rnam par dag pa dang*/ dri ma med pa'i rnam par dag pa gnyis rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'bras bu la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gnyis/ mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob gnyis kyi 'bras bu spangs rtogs mdor bstan pa/ dpe gsum gyis nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa dang*/ dpe dgus rtogs pa sku gsum gyi yon tan bstan pa gnyis kyis de nyid dpe dang sbyar te rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /las kyi don la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad do/ /de la gnyis/ sku gnyis dang | de nyid las gsum du dbye ba gnyis kyi las kyi gzhi gang yin pa/ de la brten pa'i las so/ /de la gnyis/ rang don gyi las dang*/ gzhan don gyis las so/

/dang po la gnyis/ chos bzhi mdor bstan pa dang*/ de nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la bzhi/ zag pa med pa/ khyab pa/ brtan pa/ zhi ba/ rtag pa/ 'pho ba med pa bzhis 'dus ma byas/ dkar po'i chos kyi gnas su bstan pa'o | | ldan pa'i grogs la gsum/ zag med kyi chos bco lnga mdor bstan pa/ sku gnyis kyi rten du brtan pa/ chos bco lnga po'i so so'i don rgyas par bshad pa'o | | 'jug pa'i don la gsum/ 'jug pa'i ngo bo sku gsum gyi rnam gzhaga'ajug pa'i dus brtag pa/ 'jug pa'i khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ mjug bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis | sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi 'jug pa spy-ir bstan pa/ de nyid kyi khyad par rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /de la gsum/ chos kyi sku/ longs sku/ sprul pa'i sku'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ mtshan nyid lnga/ ngo bo dang sgrub byed kyi gtan tshigs gnyis kyis yon tan lnga pa bstan pa'o/ /longs sku la gnyis/ yon tan lnga rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ don bsdu ba gnyis kyis mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas bshad do | | sprul pa'i sku la gsum/ ji ltar sprul pa'i tshul/ gang la sprul pa'i don/ bstan pa'i chos gsum gyis lam la ma zhugs pa 'jug zhugs pa smin par mdzad pa/ smin pa lung ston pa'o/ /'jug pa'i dus brtag pa la gnyis/ chos bcu mdor bstan pa so so'i don gtan la dbab pa dang*/ de dag sku gnyis so so la sbyar ba gnyis kyis rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /'jug pa'i khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyu gang gis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos drug dang*/ gang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sku gnyis dang*/ sus bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gang zag gsum gyis rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /don gsum pa/ dbyer med pa'i yon tan la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis kyis rten dang brten pa'i rnam gzhag spy-ir bstan pa/ rten yod pa bye brag tu bshad pa'o | |

de la gsum/ dpe'i sgo nas mdor bstan pa/ don rgyas par bshad/ dpe don sbyar bas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ yon tan nyid rgyas par bshad pa/ de nyid rgyas par gang du rtogs par bya ba'i mdo smos pa'o/ / dang po la gnyis/ bral ba'i yon tan/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis ngo bo dang*/ chu zla dang chos mtshungs sbyar ba gnyis kyis rnam par smin pa'i yon tan no/ / bral ba'i yon tan la gsum/ stobs bcu'i ngo bo dang*/ rdo rje dang chos mtshungs sbyar ba gnyis kyis stobs bcu/ mdo rgyas gnyis kyis mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i ngo bo dang*/ seng ge dang chos mtshungs sbyar ba gnyis kyis mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ mdo rgyas gnyis kyis ma 'dres pa'i chos rnams kyi ngo bo dang*/ nam mkha' dang chos mtshungs sbyar ba gnyis kyis ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad do/ /dpe don sbyar bas mjug bsdu ba la gnyis/ dpe dang chos mthun mdor bstan pa/ de nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o/ dang po la gnyis/ bral ba'i yon tan dpe dang sbyar ba | rten gzugs sku gnyis su bstan pa dang*/ sku gnyis nam mkha'i zla ba dang*/ chu nang gi zla ba dang mtshungs par bstan pa gnyis kyis rnam smin gyi yon tan dpe dang sbyar ba'o/ /bral ba'i yon tan dpe dang sbyar ba la gnyis/ dpe gsum dang chos mthun sbyar ba dang*/ yon tan de rnams chos sku dang dbyer med du bstan pa'o/ /dang po la (《

zha 》+ chos )gsum gyis byed las 'dra ba dang*/ chos gsum gyi ngo bo 'dra ba gnyis kyis stobs rdo rje dang chos mthun pa/ dpe'i chos bzhis mdor bstan pa dang*/ chos bzhi don la sbyar te rgyas par bshad pa gnyis kyis mi 'jigs pa seng ge dang chos mthun pa/ don lnga mtshon pa'i dpe lngar bzhag pa dang*/ mi mtshungs pa'i khyad par bzhag pa gnyis kyis ma 'dres pa nam mkha' dang chos mthun pa'o/ /bzhi pa mdzad pa'i phrinalas la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad do/ /de la gsum/ lhun gyis grub pa/ rgyun mi 'chad pa/ dpe dgus lhun grub kyi don nges par bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ mdo rgyas gnyis kyis mdzad pa lhun gyis grub pa/ mdzad pa po lhun gyis grub pa'o | | de la gsum/ /mdo rgyas gnyis kyis don bstan pa/ dpe bstan pa/ dpe don sbyar ba'o/ /dpe dgus lhun grub kyi don nges par bya ba la bzhi/ dpe dgus don dang sbyar te so sor bshad pa/ dpe bstan pa'i dgos pa dang*/ gang la bshad pa'i mdo dang*/ de thos pa'i phan yon dang*/ gang bzung ba dpes mtshon pa'i don bzhis thun mong du gtan la dbab pa/ lhun gyis grub pa'i don dgu dang*/ de nyid zhi ba dang rang gi ngo bo skye 'jig dang bral ba dang*/ gzhan la skye 'jig snang ba'i rgyu mtshan bzhis don gtan la dbab pa/ dpe don mtshungs pa dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad par gyis don bsdu ba'o/ /dpe dgu don dang sbyar te so sor bshad pa la dgu/ dpe bstan pa/ don bstan pa/ dpe don sbyar ba/ mjug bsdu ba bzhis sku snang ba brgya byin gyi gzugs brnyan gyi dpes bstan pa/ gsung lha'i rnga bo che'i dpes bstan pa/ chos sprin gyi dpes bstan pa/ sprul pa tshangs pa chen po'i dpes bstan pa/ ye shes 'phro ba nyi ma'i dpes bstan pa/ dpe bstan pa/ don bstan pa/ dpe don sbyar ba/ rnyed par dka' ba bzhis rtog pa med par/ re ba bskangs pa nor bu'i dpes bstan pa/ dpe dang don bstan pa gnyis kyis gsung brjod 'dod med pa sgra brnyan gyi dpes bstan pa/

de dpe dang don bstan pa gnyis kyis/ thugs dmigs su med pa nam mkha'i dpes bstan pa/ dpe dang don bstan pa gnyis kyis gzhan gyi dge ba'i gzhi byed pa sa'i dpes bstan pa'o/ /gsung lha'i rnga bo che'i dpes bstan pa la gnyis | dpe bstan pa/ dpe don bstan pa/ dpe don sbyar ba/ mjug bsdu ba bzhis rnga dang mtshungs pa/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis kyis lha'i sil snyan gyi dper mi rung bas khyad par du 'phags pa/ gsung khyab kyang ma thos pa rang gi nyes par bstan pa'o/ /sprin gyi dpes bstan pa la gnyis/ dpe bstan pa/ don bstan pa/ dpe don sbyar ba/ mjug bsdu ba bzhis sprin dang mtshungs pa spy-ir bstan pa/ snod kyi dbang gis du mar 'gyur ba/ ltos pa med par 'jug pa | sdug bsngal gyis mi 'jil bar byed pa gsum gyis chos dang mtshungs pa rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /sprul pa tshangs chen gyi dpes bstan pa la gnyis/ dpe bstan pa/ don bstan pa/ dpe don sbyar ba/ mjug bsdu ba bzhis sprul pa snang ba tshangs pa dang 'dra ba/ thub pa'i sprul pa mya ngan las 'das pa tshangs pa mi snang ba dang 'dra ba'o/ /ye shes 'phro ba nyi ma'i dpes bstan pa la gsum/ chos mtshungs sbyar ba/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i don/ 'jig rten du phan bde'i las (《 zha 》+ gnyis )mdzad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ mdo rgyas gnyis kyis don mdzad pa la rtog pa med par mtshungs pa/ yul dang ngo bo dang las la mtshungs pa | snod dag par 'char ba mtshungs pa/ mdo rgyas gnyis kyi rim gyis 'bebs par mtshungs pa'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa de la mos pa'i phan yon la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po la gnyis/ gang la mos pa'i yul/ de la mos pa'i phan yon dngos so/ /de la gnyis/ dge ba gzhan zil gyis gnon pa spyir bstan pa/ sbyin pa las byung ba/ tshul khrims las byung ba/ bsgoms pa las byung ba'i dge ba zil gyis gnon pa gsum gyis rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/

gang la mos pa'i yul/ mos pa'i (《 zha 》+ tshul ) phan yon dang bcas pa'o/ /de la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ /de la gnyis/ mos tshul rgyas bshad dang*/ phan yon rgyas bshad do/ /de la gsum/ yon tan gyi snod du 'gyur ba/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyal sras su 'gyur ba/ bsod nams gzhan rdzogs shing dag par byed pas mchog tu bstan pa'o/ /de la gsum | mdor bstan rgyas bshad/ gang rdzogs shing dag par bya ba'i bsod nams gsum du bsdu ba/ rdzogs par byed pa'i gegs dang dag par bya ba'i sgrib pa ngos gzung ba/ gang gi rdzogs shing dag par byed pa gzhi dang bcas pa gsum gyis shin tu rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /spy-i don gnyis pa mthar phyin pa mjug gi don la gnyis/ bstan bcos ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/ de ltar mdzad pa'i dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ gang la brten nas mdzad pa/ spyir bstan pa/ dgos pa gang gis don du mdzad pa/ lung la brten pa'i tshul bye brag tu bshad pa/ lung dang 'gal bar byed pa dgag pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis | thub pa'i bka' la brten pa dang*/ bka'i mtshan nyid bshad pa gnyis kyis gang la brten pa'i tshul/ ji ltar brten nas mdzad tshul gyis bstan bcos yang dag pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'o/ /lung dang 'gal bar byed pa dgag pa la gnyis/ ji skad gsungs pa'i mdo sde mi dkrugs pa dang*/ nyes pa gang las 'byung ba'i rgyu gzhan lta spang ba gnyis kyis chos log par 'chad pa dgag pa/ chos spang ba dgag pa'o/ /de la gnyis/ gang gis chos spang ba'i rgyu/ spangs pa'i nyes dmigs so/ /de la gnyis/ chos spangs pas mnar med du 'gyur ba dang | chos la sdang ba thar pa'i skabs med par bstan pa'i zhar las spangs pa'i phan yon bshad pa'o/ /thugs rje'i chu 'dzin legs par char 'bebs pa | | mi pham klu dbang gsung rab rin chen gter/ /gsal byed bsdus don blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po zhes byas legs par sbyar ba yin/ /gzhung 'di shing yos dbyar zla ra ba yi/

/nyin gcig nyid la rdzogs par thos nas su | | sa lug dpyid 'bring tshar gcig bshad pa'i tshe/ /bdag dang gzhan yang phan pa'i yid kyis bsdebs/ /snga mas sbyar ba'i rnam bshad bsdus don yang*// ma mthong bshad pa'i ngag la'ang ma brten pas/ /nongs par gyur gang bdag gi kho nar zad/ /de slad blo mchog rnams la bzod par gsol/ /dge ba de yis srid pa thams cad du/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin chen gter | | rnam par bzung nas 'gro la yid bzhin du/ /chos kyi sby-in pa lhug par gtong gyur cig /de ltar zab mo'i don la rnam dpyod pa'i/ /blo gros rab gsal gang gi gsung gi zer/ /rab 'phro las byung de 'dra'i 'od 'gyed pa/ /skye rgu'i sgron ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi bsdus pa'i don 'di ni/ chos kyi rje mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo rnyog pa med pa la spy-i bos gus par gtugs shing*/ gsung gi bdud rtsis blo gros kyi lus rnam par bskyed pa/ 'phags pa'i ming dang ldan pas | rgya'i yul rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' go pe la'i pho brang chen por sbyar ba'o || || ༄༅/ /skyo ba'i gtam bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ na mo gu ru mañju nā thā ya/ thugs kyi bang mdzod yon tan nor bus gtams/ /gsung snyan ka la piṅka ltar sgrogs shing*/ /ri bong 'dzin ltar gsal ba'i sku mnga' ba'i/ /zhabs pad bung ba'i phreng bas bsten la 'dud/ /mi rtog goms slad ngar 'dzin 'ching bral yang*/ /∶dul ba'i (《 zha 》 gdul bya'i )snang ngor smon lam dbang gis ni/ /ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dbus na nyi ma ltar/ /lhang nger bzhugs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sā la'i dbang po lta bur rab brtan zhing*/ /sa le sbram ltar dri med gsal ba'i thugs// sā lu'i 'bras ltar dpag yas skye rgu'i tshe(《 zha 》 yi ) / /nyer 'tshor gyur pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/gdul bya nyams pa'i gnas las drang ba'i phyir/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo las chos/ /nyung ngu'i tshig gis rgya che'i don gsal ba | | ngo mtshar rnam par 'byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i yon tan cha shas kyang*/ /rgya mtshor lta bur zab cing rgya che zhing*/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal chu las bsgral bya'i phyir/ /cho ga'i gru gzings stsol mdzad rgyal gyur cig /zar ma'i me tog rnam par rgyas 'dra yi/ /mig gi dbang pos gang gi 'od zer gyi/ / zur tsam mthong na kun nas dad pa'i yid/ /zar zir g.yo bar mdzad slad dam par 'tshal/ /de slad 'dzam bu'i chu gter ltar dwangs pa/ /'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan spyan gyis legs gzigs pas/ /'dzem pa'i yid bral chos la dbang sgyur zhing*/ /dpal kun bdag la 'dzom par mdzad du gsol/ /'dod 'jo'i ba ltar dngos grub kun 'byung zhing*/ /dpal gyi be'u sogs mtshan dpe'i dpal mnga' ba/ /bu ram shing pa'i rgyud du gang 'khrungs pa/ /skye bo kun skyob skyob pas bdag skyobs shig /gang gis bdud kyi rgyal mtshan rab bsnyil nas | | gzhung lugs ngan pa'i ba dan snyol mdzad cing*/ /bdag lta'i ri bo kun nas snyil byed pa/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga'i thugs mnga' yud tsam dgongs/ / mkha' ltar yangs pa'i blo gros dang ldan zhing*/ /nyes skyon yungs 'bru tsam gyis ma gos pa/ /rtag tu mi yengs 'gro la phan dgongs pa'i/ /yongs su 'dzin pa'i bshes la bdag dad kyang*/ /skye rgu nyin mor byed pa rgyal ba'i gsung*/ / rnam par mi nyan yid la mi byed pa'i/ /nyon mongs khol po'i tshogs kyis bsgrubs pa yis/ /bdag yid nyes pa'i tshul yang 'di ltar snang*/ /skyabs mchog dri med gsum la brten bzhin du/ /skyob pa'i gsung la yid kyang mi rton zhing | | skyon ldan bya ba brtun nas sgrub byed pas/ /bdag yid skyo ba brten par bskyed par 'gyur/ /sems kyi tha ba kun nas ma thul zhing*/

/legs par 'doms pa'i ngag la'ang the tshom skyed/ /blo gros yangs pa rnams la tho 'tshams pa | | thub mchog rnams kyi rnam thar 'di 'dra lags/ /brtul zhugs 'dzin pa nyid du dam 'cha' zhing*/ /mchod 'os nyid du nye bar khas 'che bzhin/ /'chi ba'ang mi dran sdug bsngal myu gu yi/ /chu ba 'phel ba de dag gyi na'i bshes// log par rlom pa'i yid kyi gzengs mtho zhing*/ /chags dang sdang ba'i tsher mas rnam par gzings/ /dran pa'i gzungs dang bral zhing dregs pa yis/ /gzengs bstod gyur pa'i tshogs la bsnyen par dka'/ /dam pa'i srol bzang lam las phyir phyogs shing*/ /dman pa'i lugs ngan rgyan ltar bsrel byed pa/ /sril ltar gang la brten pa rlag byed pa/ /srul po ltar yang de dag bltar mi 'tshal// rang la rjes dpag gzhan la log par lta/ /dam chos ring spong lha dang bla ma yi | | grogs dang bral bas reng bur gnas gyur pa/ /de dag bsten par rung snyam ma mchis so/ /tshul min yid kyi dba' klong rab 'khrugs shing*/ /brlang ba'i ngag smra shin tu khengs pa'i yid/ /rab tu brling zhing mdza' ba mi brtan pas | | rlung ltar g.yo ba rnams kyis bdag yid bskyod/ /bslab pas ma bsdams sems kyang yan gtong zhing*/ /skyon dang yon tan rnam par mi dpyod par | | 'di nyid yin zhes rang dgar gang smra ba/ /de dang yun du 'grogs par bdag mi 'tshal/ /lang tsho'i dpal gyis dregs shing blo yi mig /tshul min yid byed ling tog gis khebs pa/ /rtag tu long ba lta bur gyur rnams la/ / lung rigs snang ba don du ji ltar 'gyur/ /rna ba'i snyim pas rnam par mi 'dzin cing | | snyom gnas sgrub pa'i ro myang mi 'tshol la/ /snyems bral bdud rtsi'i gsung gi char phab kyang*/ /phan pa 'gyur ba snyam yang mi bgyid do/ /ji ltar chu klung du ma 'bab pa yis/ /rgya mtsho'i klong ltar 'byor pas tshim med cing*/ / rin chen gling du'ang mching bu'i phyir rtsod pa/

/de la chos kyi gleng bas ci zhig bgyi | | yid kyang ma zh-i dbang po ma dul bas/ /'tshogs na ca co ga zha'i sgra 'byin cing*/ /sri zhu'i yid dang bral bas mchod 'os la'ang*/ /zhe sar bgyid pa lta yang ga la mchis/ /skye bo mi bsrun bdag dpal nyams pa bas/ / gzhan gyi dpal la yid bsran mi bzod cing*/ /shing ltar sgron bas las su mi rung ba/ /srin po mi gzugs bzung ba nyid lags grang*/ /skyob pas legs gsungs yang dag lam bzang las/ /logs su 'dong zhing rgyal pos bcas pa yi | khrims lugs las kyang 'da' bar spyod byed pa/ /tshul 'di ji ltar lags pa gsung du gsol/ /dam tshig ra ba rnam par 'dral byed cing*/ /re ba sun 'byin dogs pa sgrub byed pa/ /'dod pa'i ro yis myos pa'i log sgrub khur/ / ri bo'i lhun pas bdag la lji bar gyur/ /ma rungs gang dag rang dang gzhan gyi rgyud | | me yis shing ltar kun nas sreg byed pas/ /mu mtha' med pa'i srid lam rgyu ba la/ /mi mchog rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yul min na/ kha na ma tho'i tshogs dang bcas gyur cing*/ khe dang bkur sti'i 'du 'dzis rnam g.yengs pas/ khu 'phrig can gyi chos gting ma 'tshal ba/ kho bo lta bus smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal | | de 'dra gcig dang gnyis su ma bas te/ /du mar gyur slad du ma'i dpung brjid pas/ /do zla tsam du'ang bdag gis ma spyod slad/ /di ring slan chad zla bral gnas par 'tshal/ /gza' dang skar ma'i tshogs rnams zil gnon pa'i/ /gzi brjid rab 'bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gzu bo'i yid ldan mi rnams dga' lags kyang*/ /drin gzo med pa'i 'byung po smon mi bgyid | | bdag kyang dad pa'i yid dang rnam bral zhing*/ /dud 'gro ji bzhin phyogs kyang mi 'tshal la/ /las kyis ded pas yid la sdug bsngal rma/ /dod par gyur pa gso phyir thugs rjes dgongs/ /drang srong bla ma khyod kyi thugs rje yi | | phyag gis sdug bsngal 'dam las bdag drongs la/

/byang chub shing drung bdud kyi sde 'joms shing*/ /gzhan gyi drin mi 'jog par mdzad du gsol/ / 'jag mi srin bu'i bar snyed 'gro ba kun/ /'jig rten 'dren pa gshegs pa'i lam bzang la/ /kun nas 'jug cing rdo rje lta bu yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog gyur cig /sa skya'i 'jam mgon zhabs la gus gtugs shing*/ /skyu ru ra yi tshul gyis lus ldan yang*/ /skye med don la nges pa'i blo gros can/ /skyo ba'i yid can 'phags pa zhes bya bas/ /sha sogs ma dag zas rnams rnam spangs shing*/ /shwa sogs rtse 'jo'i sbyor bas ma g.yengs par/ /shi rga med pa'i lam la rab 'dun pa/ /shu ki zhes bya'i dgon par sbyar ba yin/ /skyo ba'i gtam tshigs su bcad pa sum cu rtsa lnga pa zhes bya ba/ sa mo lug gi lo dbyu gu'i zla ba la sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /ngan pa'i spyod tshul la khrel ba'i gtam bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /'dir smras pa/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir snyigs ma'i ngang tshul can | | snyigs ma'i lam la kun nas gzhol gyur pa/ /de dag rnams kyi bsam dang spyod pa'i tshul/ /snyigs mar gyur pa'i tshul yang 'di ltar snang*/ /bdag bde gzhan yang bde bar 'dod bzhin du/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /gsung gi mdzod la blo gros mi 'jug pa/ /de 'dra'i tshul la kho bos mtshar du brtsis/ /dal 'byor yon tan phun sum tshogs gyur cing*/ /dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes su bzung bzhin du/ /don chen mi bsgrub phyi mar smon 'debs pa/ /de 'dra'i tshul la kho bos mtshar du brtsis/ /bde mchog bde blag thob byed bla ma la/ /skyabs su song nas nye bar bsten bzhin du/ /'bad nas de gsung legs par mi bsgrub gang*/ /de 'dra'i tshul la kho bos mtshar du brtsis

| | gang zhig sems kyis bla mar gsol 'debs bzhin/ /lus dang ngag gis bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /nye bar ston pa'i thugs sun 'byin pa gang*/ /de 'dra'i tshul la kho bos mtshar du brtsis/ /brtse bas gdams pa'i tshig gi nyi khu gang | | nye bar byin pa'i tshe na mi 'thung zhing*/ /gzhan du ji ltar bya zhes 'dri ba gang | | de 'dra'i tshul la kho bos mtshar du brtsis/ /yon tan rgya mtshor mchod par mi brtson zhing*/ /rkang gnyis dbang po'i gsung don mi gnyer bar/ /rang la legs par 'byung bar re ba gang*/ /de 'dra'i tshul la kho bos mtshar du brtsis | | blo mchog rnams kyi rjes su mi 'jug cing*/ /∶dam pa'i ngag las nges par (《 zha 》 rtsa lag dam pa'i ngag las )brgal bzhin du/ /rang gi don kun 'grub par re ba gang*/ /de 'dra'i tshul la kho bos mtshar du brtsis/ /dam pa rnams la rtag tu 'dzur zhing 'bros/ /skye bo dman pa rnams la bag phab nas/ /rang gi kun spyod mdzes par re ba gang*/ /de 'dra'i tshul la kho bos mtshar du brtsis/ / zab dang rgya che ngag tshig brling po can/ /bsgom bya'i don la blo gros mi sbyor bar | | bsgoms pa tsam gyis grol bar re ba gang*/ /de 'dra'i tshul la kho bos mtshar du brtsis/ /bsgrub par nus bzhin don chen mi bsgrub par/ kho bo le lo che bas mi 'grub ces/ /skyon la yon tan bzhin du snyems pa gang*/ /de 'dra'i tshul la kho bos mtshar du brtsis/ /skye bo log par sred pa'i srad bu yis/ /rnam par bcings pas skye ngan la dga' ba/ /de dag tshul bzhin sems dpa'i yid ldan zhing*/ /skye bo dam pa'i spyod la gzhol gyur cig /'di yang 'dir smos spyod tshul dang ldan pa/ /du ma'i ngang tshul mthong bas de bzlog phyir/ /blo gros dam pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal 'dzin pas/ /me sbrul rgyal gy-i zla bar sbyar ba yin// //༄༅/ /theg pa'i rnam dbye (《 zha 》+ mdor )bsdus pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /theg pa'i rnam par dbye ba zhes bya ba/

'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems kyi gzhir brten nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i thabs tshul gyis/ /bla med go 'phang legs brnyes pa/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /theg pa rnams kyi khyad par ni/ /shes nas ji bzhin rab spyad nas | | sangs rgyas go 'phang thob 'dod pas/ /bskul ba'i don du 'di bshad do | | gnas skabs kyi ni bde sdug la/ /blang dor byed pa phal pa ste/ /de y-i don la blang dang dor/ /byed pa grub mthar zhugs pa yin/ /'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing*/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med la/ /zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal zhing*/ /mya ngan 'das pa zhi ba zhes/ /phyag rgya bzhi po khas 'che zhing | | dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni sangs rgyas pa yin te/ / de dang mi ldan phyi rol pa'o/ /nges 'byung tshul khrims gzhir brten nas/ / bden pa rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtogs nas su/ /'du 'dzi'i yul dang yid spangs nas/ /rnam par dag pa'i spyod pa dang*/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba'i lam brtson pas/ /gnas skabs kun nas ldang ba yi/ /yid ni nye bar zhi gyur pas/ /re zhig yang srid mi len pa/ /de ni theg pa chung ngu yin/ /lta ba bdag med gnyis ldan zhing*/ /snying rje chen po las byung ba'i/ /spyod pa gzhan don nyer bsgrubs la/ /stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug pa'i/ /bsgom pas rang yid dul byas nas/ /sa bcu dang ni lam lnga la/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum sogs par/ /brtson pas lam gyi rgyun gyi mthar/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis | | sgrib pa bag chags bcas spangs nas/ /bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa | | sgrub byed pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /sngags kyi khyad par bzhag pa ni/ /slob dpon kṛ pi ka ma las/ /don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang*/ /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*/ /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs dgongs pa'ang gsang sngags pas/

/byang chub sems dang stong nyid dang*/ /snying rje nyid ni lam gyi gzhir/ /dgongs pa'i phyir na don gcig pa/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor chen po yis/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma las/ /dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par blang*/ /de tshe dbang gi ye shes kyis | | lta ba dug med rtogs pas na/ /gzhi dang lta ba rtogs pa'i thabs/ /ma rmongs pa zhes bya ba ste/ /'di ni khyad par dang po yin/ /rgya chen bskyed pa'i rim pa yis/ /lus dang skye ba sbyong ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams dag pa dang*/ / sems can yongs su smin par byed/ /zab mo rdzogs pa'i rim pa yis/ / sems dang 'chi ba sbyong ba dang*/ /nang gi sa dang lam bgrod nas/ /ting 'dzin ye shes mngon du byed/ /gzhan yang zhi rgyas dbang dang ni/ /mngon spyod sogs pa'i thabs mang pos/ /tshe ring ba dang nad med dang*/ /shes rab rnam par spel ba yis/ /lam gyi yan lag rdzogs byed pa/ /thabs mang pa zhes brjod pa yin | | ji ltar sngags kyis byin brlabs pas/ /dug kyang bdud rtsir 'gyur ba ltar(《 zha 》 yin )/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par gyis/ /nyon mongs rnams dang 'dod yon kun/ /yang dag lam du yongs bsgyur nas/ /bde ba kun la longs spyod pa/ /dka' ba med pa'i khyad par yin/ /sngags dang sman dang ting 'dzin gyis | | tshe yi dngos grub bsgrubs nas ni/ /rig 'dzin tshe dang lus bzang pos | | tshogs gnyis myur du 'dum byas nas/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob byed pas | | dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas zhes/ /myur du 'grub pa'i khyad par yin// de dag gi yang don bsdu na/ /dbang bskur ba yi gzhir brten nas/ /rim gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /sa ni bcu gnyis rab bgrod nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa dge ba/ /bcu gsum pa ni thob 'gyur ba/ /'di dag sngags kyi rnam gzhag yin/ /de phyir dbang bskur shin tu gces/ /dad dang 'dun pa rab ldan zhing*/ /bsgrub pa snying por byed pa yi/

/ri khrod bsten pa tshul gzhon gyis | | gsol ba btab nas 'phags pas sbyar/ /dge bas gsol ba 'debs byed pas/ /gtso byas sems can thams cad kyis/ /theg pa gnyis kyi tshul zhugs nas/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /theg pa'i rnam par dbye ba mdor bsdus pa 'di ni 'phags pas/ me pho byi ba'i lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig la/ mdo khams kyi sa'i cha zla snying mar me mdo zhes bya bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya ba'o// //༄༅/ /bsam gtan shes rab kyi dris lan bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor legs bshad 'od zer can/ /chos rje chos kyi nyi ma la btud de | | gang gis dri ba byas pa de yi lan/ /mdo tsam bshad pa 'di la gus pas nyon | | theg pa gsum dang sde snod gsum rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum du bsdus te nyams su len pa'i tshul ji ltar lags zhes zer ba la/ thog mar theg pa gsum ngos gzung na thun mong du grags pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin par grags pa gnyis yod/ thun mong du grags pa/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang*/ theg pa chen po'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa la grags pa ni/ theg pa chung ngu/ theg pa chen po/ rdo rje theg pa gsum yin/ sde snod gsum ni/ 'dul ba/ mdo sde/ mngon pa gsum yin/ de la 'di'i skabs su bab pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa gsum cig car nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ spy-ir sdig to mi dge ba'i phyogs tsam la ldog pa theg pa chung ngu'i nyams len thams cad 'du ba yin la/ gzhan gyi don gtso bor gyur pas dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bsgrub pa la nan tan du byed pa theg pa chen po'i nyams len thams cad 'du zhing rang gi lus ngag yid gsum de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig tu byin gyis rlob pa la nan tan du byed par rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len thams cad 'du bas/

ting nge 'dzin re re'am/ cho ga re re la'ang | gsum ldan du nyams su blangs pas theg pa gsum cig car nyams su blang bar 'gyur ba yin/ sde snod gsum cig car nyams su len pa'i tshul yang de nyid du 'du mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'dir dmigs kyis bsal ba cung zad logs su brjod na/ tshul khrims kyi tshogs kyis lus bsdams nas nyon mongs pa'i kun nas sdang ba mngon du rgyu 'dul ba ni/ 'dul ba nyams su len pa'i tshul yin zhing*/ bsgom par bya ba dang*/ nyams su blang bar bya ba'i gdams pa dang*/ rjes su gdams pa'i tshig thos pas de gzhan la ston pa'i ngag yongs su dag cing | don sems la nges pas/ mtha' gzhan du rtog pa dang*/ the tshom dang bral ba'i tshul nan tan du byed pa/ mngon pa nyams su len pa'i tshul yin la/ de ltar nges pa'i phyi nang gi dmigs pa la yid rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pas zhi gnas bskyed de/ ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyis yid yongs su dag par byed pa la nan tan du byed pa ni/ mdo sde nyams su len pa'i tshul yin no/ /de dag rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum du bsdus te nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ gong du bstan pa'i dmigs pa'i chos thams cad dang*/ gzhi phung po khams dang*/ skye mched bden pas stong par shes pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang*/ bsgom pa dang*/ lam la mtshan mar mi lta ba/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa dang*/ nyams su myong ba dang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid med par shes pas smon par mi byed pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pa ste/ dge ba'i chos thams cad/ de ltar nyams su len pa ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyis bsdus te nyams su len pa yin no/ /theg pa gsum dang sde snod gsum/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum mo/ /bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i tshul/ /'di la khyed yid dga' bar gyis/ /chos tshul 'di la rab 'dun pa/ /bsam gtan shes rab kyis bskul nas/

/dge slong 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar/ /dge des 'gro kun bde legs shog /me mo yos bu'i lo smin drug gi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin par 'dam du bris pa'o// //༄༅/ /ka sogs sum cu la spel ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ na mo mañju gho ṣā ya/ ka la piṅka'i dbyangs ltar snyan gsung gis/ kha na ma tho'i tshogs 'joms thar pa'i gling*/ /ga la ba der gdul bya 'dren mdzad cing*/ /nga dang nga yir 'dzin spangs de la 'dud/ /ca co rtsod dang rnam par g.yeng ba kun/ /cha shas kyi ni rnam par spang bya zhing*/ /ja sogs kun la'ang ma chags zla ba ni/ /nya ba lta bur zhi zhing des pa bya/ /ta la'i sdong po kun nas rgyas pa ltar/ /tha dad yon tan lo 'dab du mas phyug /da ltar gnas dang ma 'ongs 'gro ba kun/ /na sogs gdung skyob bsil grib ldan par bya/ /pa la sha yi me tog rgyas pa ltar/ /pha rol phyin drug yongs su rdzogs byas te/ /ba mchog dpag bsam shing dang bum bzang bzhin/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i re ba bskang bar bya/ /tsa kor ku mud kyis tshim pad mo'i tshal/ /tsha zer gyis rgyas byed ltar blo gsal skyongs/ /dza man a ne'i bu yis rgyal ngan ltar/ / wa skyes lta bu'i phas rgol gzhom par bya/ /zha long la sogs 'gro ba dman pa la'ang | | za ma longs spyod dang bcas ci 'byor sbyin/ /'a yig lta bur nyi 'og ma grags kyang*/ /ya mtshan che ba ltar sgrogs gangs ri yi/ /ra bas bskor ba'i gnas 'di mi dge'i bshes/ /la las sbyar ba'i lugs ngan spang bar bya/ /sha khrag mi gtsang rang lus ma chags shing*/ /sa chen lta bur gzhan gyi rten byas pas | | ha cang phongs pa'i skye rgu bde thob nas/ /a la la zhes gad mo'i sgra sgrogs shog /de ltar yi ge'i ma mo la spel nas/ /tshigs su bcad par sbyar 'di 'gro ba yi/ /sgron ma'i gsung gi zer gyis blo gsal ba/ /blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal gyis sbyar ba yin// //༄༅/ /(《 zha 》+ gzhan tshigs bcad 'thor bu kha cig zhes pa'am

)yi ge'i sbyor tshul bzhugs// ༄༅/ /swasti/ yang dag lam la rab 'bad nas/ /sa lam thams cad thar mdzad nas/ /bdag la ma chags gzhan phan mdzad/ /dam pa lags par bdag 'tshal lags/ /ci phyir nyid kyis ji bzhin gzigs shing sgrib gnyis zhi/ /dus gsum kun tu dug gsum bdud 'dul sku gsum grub/ / bde gshegs mkhyen brtse dpe med legs brnyes dge legs gter/ /skyob mchog mgon po gtso bo khyod bstod mchog sogs stsol/ /yi ge'i sbyor tshul 'di | | gzhan gyis shes bya'i phyir/ /dge slong blo gros kyis/ /rnam par sbyar ba yin || || ༄༅/ /ldan yul du skyes pa ston pa brtson 'grus kyi dris lan bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dris pa'i lan cung zad gdab par bya ste/ de la gang zag gcig gi rgyud la sdom pa gsum dang ldan pas/ nang 'gal bar snang ba byung na/ dgag bya dang*/ dgos pa bltas la/ gang dgag bya shas che ba de mi spyad par/ dgos pa shas che ba de spyad par bya/ dgag dgos cha mnyam na/ 'og ma 'og ma btang snyoms su bzhag cing*/ gong ma gong ma gtso bor spyad de/ spyod 'jug las/ chung ngu'i don du che mi gtang*/ /zhes pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin la sogs/ /gang nas gong du khyad zhugs spyad/ /ces pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis/ /gong ma gong ma rnams kyis gnod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dri ba gnyis pa'i lan la/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam bskal pa grangs med pa 'das kyang | sangs rgyas pa'i lam gyi grogs su mi 'gyur te/ byams pa'i zhal nas/ mdo sde rgyan las/ ma tshang ba dang 'gal ba dang*/ /thabs min de ltar ma bstan phyir | | nyan thos kyi ni theg pa de/ /theg chen chos zhes bya ba min/ /zhes pa dang | rgyud sde dag las/ /dmyal bar 'gro ba byang chub kyi/ /gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te/ /nyan thos dang ni rang sangs rgyas/ /byang chub kyi ni gtan gyis gegs
