| | zhes bya ba gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang nyan rang gi lam la 'bad pas | nyan rang gi 'bras bu grub pa'i mthar/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rjes bskul te/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ sangs rgyas par gsungs pa ni/ nges pa'i don yin te/ dam pa'i chos pad+ma dkar po dang*/ lang kar gshegs pa dang*/ dpal phreng seng ge sgra'i mdo la sogs pa las rgya cher shes par bya'o/ /dri ba gsum pa'i lan la/ so sor thar pa'i rigs bdun gyi dbye ba ni | dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ dge slong gsum la/ skyes pa dang*/ bud med kyi rten gyi dbye bas phye ba drug dang*/ bud med kyi phyogs la/ dge tshul ma dang*/ dge slong ma'i bar dang*/ bar slob la lo gsum slob dgos la/ skyes pa'i phyogs la/ de'i dod mi dgos pas/ de ltar na rigs dang gang zag gi dbye bas bdun du 'gyur ro/ /dri ba bzhi pa'i lan/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyis sa lam thob pas/ gsang sngags nas bshad pa'i nang gi rtags thams cad nang du shugs kyis 'byung zhing*/ gsang sngags kyi nang rten 'brel gyi sa lam thob pa la'ang | pha rol tu phyin pa nas bshad pa'i phyi'i rtags rnams rim pas 'byung ba yin te/ sgrub byed kyi thabs kyi khyad ma gtogs pa bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu la khyad par med pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang thams cad la khyad med pa ma yin te/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs la sa bcu gnyis pa phyin chad kyi sgrub byed kyi thabs ma gsungs pas 'bras bu'ang (《

zha 》+ gzhan )med la/ gsang sngags la ni thabs dang 'bras bu gnyis ka gsungs so/ /dri ba lnga pa'i lan/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams la/ zab mi zab kyi khyad med kyang*/ bsgrub thag ring thung byung ba ni/ sngon gyi las 'phro yod med kyi dbang gis 'byung ba yin/ dri ba drug pa la/ thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'ang*/ las 'phro'i khyad par yod mod/ 'on kyang rje btsun ma sgrol ma bsgrub thag nye ba yin zhes/ rgya gar dang bod kyi chen po rnams zhal mthun par gsungs par 'dug dri ba bdun pa la/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i thabs kyi mthar thug gi 'bras bu grub pa'i dus nam yin zer ba ni/ spy-ir rnal 'byor bla na med pa la ye ma brten pa'i rgyud sde 'og ma rkyang pas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob mi srid de/ brtag gnyis las/ thams cad rig byed grub mtha' dang*/ /de bzhin las rgyal la sogs pas/ /srid pa dag 'gyur dngos grub min/ /yang ni srid mthar skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ las rgyas ni/ phrin las rgyas pa gtsor ston pa/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud man chad la zer ba yin/ 'og ma 'og ma la goms pas/ gong ma gong ma'i snod du gyur nas/ ring por mi thogs par rnal 'byor chen po nyid kyis/ sangs rgyas pa'i 'bras bu mngon du byed la 'bras bu nam 'grub kyi dus kyi dbye ba ma gsungs/ des na snga phyi yod kyang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags bla med ltar khyad par chen po med do/ /'dir smras pa/ so so thar pas lus ngag gi /nyes pa'i chu lon nyid byas te/ /byang chub sems la gzhi byas nas/ /rig 'dzin snying po'i tshul du spyad/ /gang zag gcig gi nad rigs la'ang*/ /sman dpyad 'gal bar snang ba ltar/ /theg pa'i rim pa'ang gnas skabs kyis/ /byed pas 'gal ba ltar snang yang*/ /gnas skabs dbye ba shes pa yis/ /rnal 'byor pa la 'gal ba med/

/nang dang phyi yi dgag dgos dang*/ /sbyar nas spyod pa mkhas pa yin/ /sdom pa phra mo'ang gces par bsrung*/ /bdag pas gzhan gces blo dang ni/ /bla ma dang ni dkon mchog gsum | | rang dang gnyis su med mthong ba/ /de tshe sngags dang phar phyin gyi/ / sdom dang dam tshig lhun grub yin/ /de ltar khyod kyis shes byas la/ /sdom pa gsum po tshul bzhin bsrung*/ /ring por mi thogs rgyal ba yi/ /ye shes rgya mtshor 'jug par 'gyur/ /ldan gyi yul du skyes pa'i ston pa brtson 'grus zhes bya bas dris pa'i lan/ 'phags pas shing mo phag gi lo/ gdu bu'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu lnga'i nyin par gdams pa'o// // ༄༅/ /byang chub lam gyi snying po (《 zha 》+ sgom pa'i rim pa )bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /byang chub lam gyi snying po zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir blo dang ldan pas bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa'i tshul ni gnyis te/ shin tu brtson pas dka' ba spyad de myur du 'tshang rgya ba dang*/ thabs la mkhas pas 'jug pa bde mos rim gyis 'tshang rgya ba gnyis te/ ji skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo/ ngas brtson 'grus 'bar bar byas pas (《 zha 》 bas )myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ ngas tshor ba sdug bsngal ba/ drag pa/ rtsub pa/ ji lta bu dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ zhes pa dang*/ kun dga' bo/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas ni sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa na thabs la mkhas pas yongs su zin pas/ theg pa bde ba/ 'jug pa bde ba/ lam bde bas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub yang dag par bsgrubs so zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ de ltar tshul gnyis las/

'dir 'jug pa bde bas byang chub bsgrub pa'i tshul brjod par bya'o | | de'ang chos gsum gyis shes par bya ste/ spros pa dang bcas pas sngon du 'gro ba'i tshul dang*/ dngos gzhi spros pa med pa la mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ rdzogs par byed pa'i lam gyi yan lag go /dang po ni nyin lan gsum/ mtshan lan gsum du gnas dben par dkon mchog gi spyan sngar/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa bshams la/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la lan gsum du skyabs su song nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du byang chub kyi yan lag yan lag bdun sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed cing*/ ci nus kyis bsgrub pa nan tan du bya snyam pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa btsugs shing*/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas sny-ing ga'am/ spy-i bor thal mo sbyar la mdun gyi nam mkhar/ rang g-i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dgyes bzhin du bzhugs pa dang | phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams mtha' yas pa thams cad na da ltar 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ chos thams cad mkhyen cing sems can thams cad la gzigs pa/ byang chub kyi shing gi drung du rin po che'i seng ge'i khri la/ snyems pa dang*/ bag tsha ba thams cad rnam par spangs nas/ sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang*/ skyabs su lham me/ lhan ne | lhang nger bzhugs pa/ mngon par rtogs pa'i chos mngon du mdzad nas zab pa dang*/ rgya che ba'i lung gi chos gsung bzhin pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dang | nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ gang ji snyed bzhugs pa thams cad dran pa mnyam par bzhag pa'i yid kyis mngon sum ltar dmigs nas/ de dag re re'i spyan sngar yang rang gi lus 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam par sprul pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dang thabs cig tu 'khod de/

sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa de dag thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing*/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du bskyab pa dang*/ kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul lta bu'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi tshogs dang*/ sprul pa dang bcas pa'i rang gi lus dang*/ longs spyod dang dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa 'bul zhing*/ mchod pa dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags | nus tshad kyis slar bsdam pa dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi 'khor ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la zab pa dang*/ rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ srid pa ji srid du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs nas sems can rnams kyi don mdzad par gsol ba dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis sems can ∶gyi (《 zha 》 thams cad kyi )don du/ byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ byang chub kyi spyod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par spyad de/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam thams cad la rim pa bzhin du bslabs te/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i sems can thams cad kyi don bya bar khas blang ngo snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /mkhyen ldan gang gi thugs rjes bdag sogs kun/ /rjes su bzung na zab mo'i lam bstan zhing | | sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzad pa bsgrub mdzad pa/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /bla ma dam pa brgyud par bcas rnams dang*/ /dus gsum dag tu phyogs bcur bzhugs gyur pa'i

| | rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad la/ /rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing*/ / byang chub bar du nye bar skyabs su mchi/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams kun las bskyab pa dang*/ /nyid ci 'dra ba de 'drar bdag 'gyur bar/ /rnam pa kun tu byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dge ba dang*/ /yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho rnams/ /mkha' dbyings khyab par nam mkha'i srid gnas te/ /'phags rnams mchod cing 'gro kun tshim byed shog / bdag dang mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa/ /las dang nyon mongs bag chags dbang gyur pas/ /lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa gang bgyis pa/ /so sor bshags so tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ /dus gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na/ /dge ba gang dag ji snyed mchis rnams la/ /rjes su bdag yi rang zhing 'gro kun yang*/ /phan tshun yi rang dge ba 'phel gyur cig /rgyal ba kun gyi drung du bdag dang ni/ /'gro kun lhan cig mchis nas chos ston dang*/ / mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs nas sems can don/ /rtag tu mdzad par gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba de dag kun gyis byang chub thugs/ /bskyed nas mchog brnyes 'gro ba'i don mdzad ltar/ /bdag gis kyang ni byang chub sems bskyed nas/ /spyod pa dag la rim bzhin bslab par bgyi/ /zhes rkang gi khong*/ rus pa'i gting thag pa nas lan gsum mam bdun gyi bar du brjod par bya'o// de nas stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gis ci bde bar 'dug la/ cung zad ngal bsos nas gong du brjod pa'i yan lag bdun pa rnams kyi don dran par bya zhing 'khor ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ smon pa dang*/ 'jug pa dang*/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang | stong pa dang*/ snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i lam gyi rang bzhin dang*/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/

de'i yon tan dang*/ phrin las rnams la skye ba rim pa bzhin yas mar dang*/ gang zhig gang la rag las pa'i rim pas mas yar dang*/ khyad par du gang la mos pa dang*/ yid la sman par 'gyur ba de la bsnan zhing*/ dran par byas te mnyam par bzhag go /spros pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro ba'i tshul lo/ /de nas dngos gzhi spros med kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ yan lag bdun pa'i rjes de nyid dam/ gzhan du'ang rung ste/ stan bde ba la rkang pa gnyis skyil mo krung dang*/ lag pa gnyis mnyam par bzhag pa dang*/ sgal tshigs drang por bsrang*/ mig sna rtser phab nas/ bla ma dang | dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ ji skad bshad pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas rang gi lus yi dam gyi lha snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar skad cig gis dmigs la/ spyi bor rang gi bla ma rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa la mos pa dang*/ gus pa drag po bsgom zhing | bdag gi rgyud la yang dag pa'i rtogs pa dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes la 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa bskyed du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab bo | | de nas phyi nang gi chos ji ltar snang ba dang*/ ji ltar myong ba 'di dag la dmigs la/ chos 'di dag thams cad ni ma brtags pa'i blo la snang zhing myong yang | rnam par brtags na gcig dang du ma dang bral ba'i phyir/ rang bzhin med bzhin du snang ba rmi lam dang 'dra zhing*/ de ltar snang ba'i chos de dag la dmigs nas dge ba dang*/ mi dge ba dang*/ mthar lta ba dang*/ lta ba dang bral ba'i yid las bde ba dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ 'khor ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa kun du 'byung ba'i phyir/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am gzhir gyur pa ni sems yin la/ sems de'ang rnam par dpyad na kha dog dbyibs su ma grub cing | gcig dang du ma dang bral ba dang*/ phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ gnyis ka na mi gnas pa'i phyir rang gi ngo bos stong zhing*/

gang la ngo bo med pa de la thog mar skye ba'i rgyus stong la/ gang ma skyes pa de mi gnas pa'i phyir bar du gnas pa'i ngo bos stong zhing*/ gang mi gnas pa de la 'gag pa med pa'i phyir tha ma 'gags pa'i 'bras bus stong ngo*/ /gang la thog ma dang*/ tha ma dang*/ ngo bo med pa de la mtha' dang*/ dbus su gdags pa cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir/ dus gsum las rnam par grol zhing mtha' dang*/ dbus med pa spros pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba 'di ni sems kyi chos nyid yin la/ de ni chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin yang yin zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku'i ngo bo yang de nyid do/ / zhes spros pa bcad nas/ yod pa dang*/ med pa la sogs pa'i mtshan mar mi 'dzin zhing*/ spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de'ang dang po ma goms pa'i tshe yod pa dang*/ med pa'i mthar ltung zhing*/ sems kyi 'du 'phro du ma 'byung yang rim gyis goms pa'i tshe/ nang du sems gsal zhing rig pa dang | phyi'i snang ba rgyun mi chad bzhin du/ mtshan ma dang*/ rnam par rtog pa dang bral zhing*/ rtog pas ma spros pa'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro | | ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun de nyid bsod nams dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyis bskrun pas/ 'jig rten pa'i lam rnams bgrod de/ mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i sgrib pa rnams spangs nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa mthong ba'i lam gyi ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin las langs nas de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad shin tu snying rje/ mi shes pa'i mun pa dang*/ las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral na/ ci ma rung snyam du snying rje chen po bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sngon du 'gro ba yan lag bdun pa dang*/ dngos gzhi mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bas gtso byas pa/ bdag dang gzhan gyi dge ba thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig snyam du bsams nas/

dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan/ /ma lus blo yis gcig tu bsdoms byas nas/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /ces lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /de nas bla ma la sogs pa mdun du dmigs pa'i yul de dag rang gi gnas su gshegs par dmigs nas rang nyid ci bde bar spyad do/ /dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ro/ /don gsum pa rdzogs par byed pa lam gyi yan lag ni/ bdag nyid sdig pa mi dge ba'i las las ldog cing*/ gal te sdig pa dang*/ ltung ba byung na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran par byas nas bshags pa dang*/ ci nus kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrub pa la brtson zhing*/ dge ba gang byas pa thams cad gzhan gyi don du bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba dang*/ gzhan dag kyang sdig pa las ldog cing*/ gal te sdig pas gos na bshags su 'jug pa dang*/ dge ba la bskul zhing bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo 'jug pa dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i byams pa/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnams rgyun du bsgom zhing*/ phyi rol na ji ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ nang du ji ltar nyams su myong ba'i sems thams cad rmi lam lta bu dang*/ de thams cad kyi rang bzhin gang gi'ang ngo bor ma grub pas spros pa dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bur rgyun tu bsam mo/ /lus dang sems la sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshe/ bdag gis sngon bsags pa'i sdig pa 'dag par 'gyur snyam pa'i dga' ba bsgom zhing*/ bdag gis 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba 'dis sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal yang zad cing

| yongs su gtugs par gyur cig snyam du bsgoms la yid zhum pa dang sgy-id lug par mi bya'o/ /lus dang sems la bde ba dang*/ dga' ba skyes pa'i tshe | dga' ba dang bde ba 'di lta bu dang*/ bde bas ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i dga' bde thams cad kyang dge ba spyad pa las byung ngo*/ /zhes dge ba'i phan yon rjes su dran pa dang*/ dge ba spyad pa de dag kyang bla ma dang*/ dkon mchog la brten nas 'byung ngo zhes yul gyi bka' drin rjes su dran par byas nas | sems can thams cad 'di lta bu dang*/ 'di bas ches lhag pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba rgyun mi 'chad pa dang ldan par gyur cig snyam du bsams nas/ bde ba'i gzhi des yid zhen pa dang*/ dregs par mi 'gyur ba la bslab par bya'o | | lam gyi yan lag go /de ltar chos gsum la rtag tu goms pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson pa ni 'jug pa bde zhing thabs sla bas byang chub kyi lam rnams rim gyis bgrod de/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dga' ba dang*/ bde ba thams cad la mngon par spyad nas/ mthar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba nyid do// de ltar lung dang man ngag ji bzhin du/ /byang chub lam gyi snying po bsgom pa'i tshul | | slob mas bskul bzhin bshad pa'i dge ba des/ /'gro kun rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig /byang chub lam gyi snying po bsgom pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ rang gi slob mas rgyang ring po nas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ dge slong 'phags pas sa pho stag gi lo gdu bu'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu gnyis la/ dpal sa ∶skya'i chos grwa chen por (《 zha 》 skyar )shin tu myur bar sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /dran pa gso thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ gang gi bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs pas | | skyon rnams rgyu dang bcas pa ring spangs shing*/ /yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs gyur pa/ /'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/

/gang gi drin gyis lta ba'i 'ching ba kun/ /rnam par bkrol nas bde chen lam ston cing | | srid dang zhi ba 'jigs pa kun skyob pa/ /'dren mchog bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab legs tshogs rgya mtsho las/ /legs pa'i man ngag nor bu rin chen tshogs/ /bshes gnyen mchog gis bdag la legs gnang ba'i/ /tshul 'di rang gis dran bzhin bri bar bya/ /srid pa 'di ni sdug bsngal rgya mtsho ste/ /nyon mongs chu srin tshogs kyis rab tu gang*/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs rab tu 'khrugs/ /'di la thog ma med cing tha ma med/ /mtha' dang dbus med zad med 'phel ba med/ /de 'dra'i rgya mtshor thog med dus nas 'khyams | | da dung du yang de rgyun ma bzlog na/ /phyi ma'i mur thug med par 'khyams gyur pas/ /'di rgyud gcad pa'i phyir na brtson par bya/ /ston pa sred pa'i 'chings las ma grol zhing*/ /bstan pa srid pa'i rgyu dang mi 'gal la/ / bshes gnyen 'jig rten phun tshogs don gnyer ba/ /de lta'i rjes zhugs de las rab 'das kyang*/ /dmus long grogs bral rgya mtshor 'jug dang mtshungs// ston pa gang zhig skyon bral yon tan rdzogs/ /bstan pa bdag lta'i gnyen po nyid gyur la/ /bshes gnyen nges 'byung lam la rab mkhas pa/ /de dag la brten srid las brgal 'dod gang*/ /ded dpon mchog ldan gru chen nang zhugs nas | | rgya mtsho las brgal rin chen gling zhugs te/ /yid bzhin nor bus bdag gzhan don grub mtshungs/ /ces pa 'di ni 'phags pas smras pa'o// //༄༅/ /dbus gtsang ∶gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la spring ba (《 zha 》 du chos 'khor bskor ba'i bka' yig )bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dge tshogs dpag med rin chen las bsgrubs shing*/ /zag pa med dbyings rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khrungs/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i bang rim yongs rdzogs pa/ / rgyal ba lhun po'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal/

/ye shes dbang po'i klu dbang gis sprul zhing*/ /shes bya'i mkha' kun rnam par khyab gyur la/ /rnam grol lo tog kun nas rgyas byed pa'i/ /dam chos rnam par sgrogs pa'i char sprin rgyal/ /lhag bsam sa bon snying rje'i chu yis bskrun/ /yon tan lo 'dab rtogs pa'i snying po can | | sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gsung zer gyis phye ba'i/ /dge 'dun chu skyes tshal rab rgyas gyur cig /gang gi lhag bsam nam mkha'i dbyings ltar dri med cing | | de yi blo gros nyin mor byed ltar rab gsal la/ /mdzad spyod dge ba zla ba tshes pa ltar mdzes pa'i/ /mi yi dbang po dbang phyug dam pa rnam par rgyal | | gang gi dad bzang dri med chu 'dzin rnam par rol pa rnam dpyod glog gi phreng ba can/ /'dun pa'i rlung shugs rab tu g.yo bas bskyod pa las byung spring yig tshig gi char rgyun gang*/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i klu dbang dang bcas tshogs kyi mchog rab 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho rab yangs par/ /bstan pa'i chu gter rnam par 'phel bas skye rgu'i nyer 'tshor nye bar gnas phyir dbab par bgyi | | rigs dang cho 'brang rnam par dag cing*/ dpal dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs la/ dad pa dang brtse ba rmad du byung bas/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan par mdzad pa can/ rgyal po chen po'i pho brang nas/ chos smra ba'i btsun pa 'phags pas/ byang chub snying po rdo rje'i gdan nas/ byang phyogs su bgrod pa'i gnas | gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba/ bde bar gshegs pa nyid kyis thub pa'i bstan pa 'phel bar lung bstan zhing*/ legs par sbyangs pa'i skyes bu dam pa 'byung ba'i gnas/ dbus dang gtsang gi sa'i cha na bzhugs pa/ legs par sbyangs pa'i thugs/ yid bzhin gyi mtsho ltar zab cing yangs la rnyog pa dang bral ba/ mang du gsan pa'i chab kyis rnam par bltams shing*/ yon tan rin po che'i gter du ma 'dzin pa/ brtse ba chen po'i rlung gi shugs kyis/

rnam par dpyod pa'i chu 'dzin spobs pa'i glog gi 'od 'gyu ba nye bar phyung nas legs par bshad pa'i char gyi rgyun rnam par phab pas/ slob ∶grwa'i (《 zha 》+ 'gro'i )skye bo'i yid kyi zhing sar rtogs pa dge ba'i lo tog rnam par bskrun par mdzad pa'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ de nyid dang tshul mtshungs pa'i zhar chos pa rnams dang*/ de dag gi rjes su 'jug cing*/ tshul khrims kyi lus yon tan gyi rgyan gyis spras shing*/ dam pa rnams kyi bgrod pa'i lam la nye bar zhugs pa/ 'dus pa rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams kyi snyan du gsol ba/ 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho bshes gnyen lhun por bcas// bstan pa rin chen sgron ma'i rten gyur khyod/ /zo bdog bde'am sku nyams dang ldan nam/ /ldang ba yang ngam gsol zas legs phrod dam/ /dgyes rgur spyod dam ji ltar dgongs pa'i don/ /chos bzhin grub bam klog dang kha ton dang*/ / bzlas brjod bsam gtan rnam par 'phel lam zhes/ /bsam pa dge bas ring nas 'dri zhing mchis/ /skabs kyi don la bdag cag gi bla ma chos kyi rje tshad med pa'i mkhyen rab dang*/ thugs rje ldan pa des/ nyid kyi don dang bde ba la ma gzigs par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spy-i dang*/ sems can spyi la phan par dgongs nas/ rgyal rgyud kyi drung du byon/ ji ltar phan pa dang don du 'gyur ba mdzad pa de thams cad kyi thugs la gsal/ de'i rjes su nged kyis kyang ji ltar nus pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i zhabs tog dang*/ sems can la gang phan bgyis pa lags/ bye brag tu rgyal po chen po 'di'i thugs dgongs la/ drang po'i chos kyis rgyal khams thams cad legs par bskyang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'ang rgyas par byed pa'i dgongs pa bzang po gda'/ khong gi drung du nged bsdad nas kyang rang gi don gtso bor ma bsgrubs par khong gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gnas lugs kyi babs thugs su chud pa dang*/

blang ba dang dor ba'i dmigs phyed pa/ chos dang chos ltar bcos pa'i rnam dbye mkhas par byas nas | sngon gyi chos rgyal kun dang rjes su mthun par bstan pa'i bdag po mdzad pa'i rkyen byas nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi la gang phan pa dang*/ mi sde spyi la gang phan gyi zhu ba yang yang byas nas/ lung dang las ka bzang po zhus nas bskur ba thams cad kyi thugs la gsal te mchi/ khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshul khrims dag pa dang*/ chos kyi bshad nyan lags pas de la phan pa'i zhu ba sngar (《 zha 》+ yang )mang du byas/ da res chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i yo byad dang*/ gser yig pa btang ba lags pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang*/ dge 'dun rnams kyis/ rgyal po chen po sku tshe ring zhing thugs dgongs chos dang mthun par 'grub pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par bya ba dang*/ sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid par bya ba'i don du/ chos bshad nyan dang*/ sgom sgrub dang*/ klog pa dang*/ kha ton dang*/ dge sbyor gyi rim pa rnams dang*/ chos kyi gtam gyis dus 'da' bar byas nas/ thugs mthun pa'i sgo nas smon lam rnam par dag pa gdab par zhu/ chos 'khor zin nas kyang dus thams cad du bshad nyan la brtson par mdzad par zhu/ khyed dge 'dun thams cad chos nyan bshad dang chos kyi bya ba legs par mdzad pa'i bdag gnyer nged kyi nus tshad kyis byed pa lags/ stong gsum 'jig rten khams 'di gser dag gis/ /bkang nas gang la sbyin pa byin pa bas/ /gang gis tshig bzhi'i tshigs bcad gcig brjod pa/ /de yi bsod nams de 'dra de la med/ /de skad lung las 'byung zhing rigs pas kyang*/ /nges par grub pa yin te gang gi phyir/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i srid zhi'i dpal 'byor kun/ /dge ba spyad pa las byung de yang ni/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i chos tshul la brten zhing | | chos de'ang thos pa nyid la rag las phyir/ /de ltar lung dang rigs pas don ched du/

/grub pa'i don la 'bad pa tshul lags pas/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab dri med dang*/ /dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa'i bstan bcos mchog /'byung khungs bzang po'i gling las byung gyur zhing*/ / mkhas pa'i ded dpon mchog las legs 'ongs la/ /blo gsal rnams kyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa/ /srid pa'i rims nad sel ba'i nor bu mchog /tshul khrims dag pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bzhag nas/ /thos dang bsam pa'i byi dor legs byas te/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i rim gros legs mchod nas/ /snyan pa'i 'od kyis sa gsum rab gsal zhing*/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa ma lus kun bsal te/ /'byor pa gnyis kyi dpal 'byor rgya mtsho yis/ /bdag gzhan thams cad kun nas rab 'byor zhing*/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i dpal yang thob par mdzod/ /gang zhig thub pa'i bstan pa dar ba'i tshe/ /chos la brtson bgyid ngo mtshar ci zhig mchis/ /snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro ba rnams la chos/ /gsal bar bgyid pa shin tu ngo mtshar lags/ /bdag gis de ltar brjod pa gang lags pa/ /de kun mkhyen bzang khyed kyi thugs la gsal/ /de lta mod kyi mi yi dbang po yis/ /'phrin gyis gdams par gyis zhes bskul ba dang*/ /zla ba'i zer gyis kun+da'i phreng ba ltar/ /dge ba'i 'dun pa kun nas rgyas phyir dang*/ dad pas glengs pa don med mi 'gyur slad/ /bdag gis de skad glengs pa'ang de ltar dgongs/ /de ltar mi yi dbang po dad pa'i yid/ /gang gis legs bshad ngag gis rab bskul nas/ /'gro ba'i don du bstan pa gnas pa'i phyir | | rin chen chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor bas/ /rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs gyur pa'i/ /rgyal ba chos kyi dbang phyug thams cad kyis// theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor nas/ /'gro kun kun mkhyen nyid du 'gyur bar shog /gnas skabs su yang sbyin bdag rgyal po yi/ /sku tshe ring zhing dbang phyug phun sum tshogs/ /bar du gcod pa thams cad nyer zhi zhing*/

/ thugs kyi dgongs pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog /'gro ba kun kyang nad dang mu ge dang*/ /kun tu 'khrug pa thams cad nyer zhi nas/ /chos dang zang zing longs spyod dri med la/ /dus rnams kun tu dga' mgur spyod par shog khyi lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la/ pho brang chen por bris pa'i yi ge phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ //༄༅/ /(《 zha 》+ dge bshes )tsha rong pa la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo | | dmigs med thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rgya che zhing*/ /ji bzhin ji snyed mkhyen pa'i 'od zer can/ /'gro ba'i yid la kun tu mnyam 'jug pa/ /sangs rgyas skye rgu'i sgron mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po nas/ 'phags pas tshul khrims (《 zha 》+ dang dam tshig )rnam par dag cing*/ spang ba dang*/ bsgrub pa'i brtul zhugs dam pa dang ldan pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen tsha rong ba'i phyag du spring ba/ chos kyi 'brel bar 'gyur ba'i yi ge zhig spring bar zhu gsung pa de bsgrub pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad de brjod pa/ tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam ji bzhin du/ /g.yo zhing mi rtag bde sdug gang myong ba/ /dran pa'i yul tsam 'gyur zhing yud tsam pas/ /tshe 'di la ni blo ldan su zhig chags/ /bde bar snang ba g.yan pa phrug 'dra zhing*/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin glo bur sdug bsngal gyis/ /kun tu gdung zhing rgyun mi chad pa yi/ /srid pa 'di la mkhas pa su zhig dgyes/ /rang gi yon tan yongs su ma rdzogs shing*/ /gzhan gyi don yang kun nas nyams gyur la/ /zad cing yongs su gtugs pa'i chos nyid can// mya ngan 'das la brtse ldan su zhig smon/ /yod par 'dzin pas 'jig tshogs lta ba 'phel/ /med par zhen pas ngan 'gro'i rgyu bsgrub la/ /gnyis kar lta bas lta ngan rnam 'phel ba'i/ /mtshan ma nyid du shes ldan su zhig zhen/ /de chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod bzhi pa/
